charge.d: Rush forward and push enemies before swinging your weapon, dealing 180% damage and Knocking Back enemies.

leap.d: Leap forward and then slam down, dealing 55% damage and Slowing enemies by 70% for 3 seconds.

war-cry.d:
Bellow a mighty war cry, increasing your damage dealt by 7.5%[x] for 4.0 seconds.

Nearby allies gain half of War Cry's effects.

ground-stomp.d: Smash the ground, dealing 50% damage and Stunning surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

death-blow.d:
Attempt a killing strike, dealing 300% damage to enemies in front of you.

rupture.d: Skewer enemies in front of you, dealing 20% damage, then rip your weapon out, inflicting 180% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

rend.d: Cleave enemies in front of you, dealing 25% damage and inflicting [534-1028]% Bleeding damage over [24.6-30.6] seconds.

steel-grasp.d: Throw out a trio of chains that deal 100% damage and Pull In enemies.

kick.d: Throw a powerful kick that deals 100% damage and Knocks Back enemies in front of you. Enemies who are Knocked Back into terrain take an additional 50% damage and are Stunned for 3 seconds.

flay.d: Flay the enemy, dealing 6% damage and inflicting 115% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

challenging-shout.d: Taunt Nearby enemies and gain 20.0% Damage Reduction for 8.0 seconds.

frenzy.d:
Unleash a rapid flurry of blows, dealing 70% damage with each pair of hits.

rallying-cry.d:
Bellow a rallying cry, increasing your Movement Speed by 20%[x] for 4 seconds.

Nearby allies gain half of Rallying Cry's effects.

iron-skin.d: Steel yourself for 3 seconds, increasing your Maximum Life by 10% and gaining a Barrier that absorbs 60.0% of your Maximum Life in damage.

upheaval.d: Tear into the ground with your weapon and fling debris forward, dealing 200% damage.

lunging-strike.d: Lunge forward and strike an enemy, dealing 90% damage.

hammer-of-the-ancients.d: Slam your hammer down with the fury of the Ancients, dealing 175% damage to a concentrated area.

bash.d:
Bash the enemy with your weapon, dealing 90% damage.

Every 5th Bash will clobber, Stunning enemies for 1.5 seconds.

double-swing.d: Sweep your weapons from opposite directions, dealing 75% damage with each weapon. Enemies caught in the center are damaged by both.

mighty-throw.d: Hurl your weapon, dealing 210% damage upon impact and sticking in the ground. While in the ground, your weapon pulses and deals 100% damage every second for 4.02 seconds.

whirlwind-bursting.d:
Whirlwind also explodes, dealing 18% Fire damage and inflicting 50% Burning damage over 5 seconds.

Whirlwind now deals Fire damage.

whirlwind-tornado.d: Whirlwind also creates 2 Dust Devils that each deal 62% damage.

whirlwind-weaken.d: Critical Strikes from Whirlwind Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.

whirlwind-channel-damage-bonus.d: Channeling Whirlwind causes it to deal 1%[x] increased damage each time it hits an enemy, stacking up to 25 times.

whirlwind-cost-damage-bonus.d: Whirlwind deals 40%[x] increased damage and costs 10 additional Fury.

whirlwind-movement-speed.d: Gain 12%[x] increased Movement Speed during Whirlwind.

whirlwind-winding.d:
Attacking with another Skill grants 4 stacks of charge up to 20 that decays over time. Your Whirlwind deals 1%[x] increased damage and gains 1%[x] Movement Speed per stack.

While Whirlwind has charges it launches Iron Shrapnel at Nearby enemies, each dealing 17% damage and inflicting 14% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

war-cry-mighty-roar.d: War Cry's damage bonus is increased by 10% and allies now receive its full effect. You also gain Berserking for 4 seconds.

war-cry-korlic.d: War Cry Summons Korlic who leaps at enemies, dealing 110% damage

war-cry-the-scream.d: War Cry terrifies your enemies, causing them to cower in Fear. You gain 0.300%[x] increased damage for each enemy Feared, up to 3.00%[x]

war-cry-ferocity.d: War Cry grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.

war-cry-slow.d: War Cry Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 4 seconds.

war-cry-duration-increase.d: War Cry's duration is increased to 6 seconds.

war-cry-vulnerable.d: War Cry makes nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

upheaval-suppress.d: Upheaval gains deals 75%[x] increased damage. Depending on the cast range, this area increases but the damage bonus decreases.

upheaval-iron-burst.d: Upheaval flings Iron Shrapnel dealing 38% damage, and inflicting 150% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

upheaval-trailblazing.d:
Upheaval ignites the ground Burning enemies for an additional 150% damage over 4 seconds.

Upheaval now deals Fire damage.

upheaval-damage-increase.d: Upheaval deals 30%[x] increased damage to the first 5 enemies hit.

upheaval-fury-cost-reduction.d: Upheaval's Fury cost is reduced to 28 Fury.

upheaval-overpower.d: Upheaval consumes 1 Overpower stack to increase Upheaval's Size by 20%[+] and damage by 20%[x].

upheaval-free-cast.d: Every 100 Fury spent makes your next Upheaval free to cast. This stacks up to 300 total Fury.

rupture-blood-pool.d: Rupture now creates a blood pool when you rip your weapon out, inflicting 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds. You and your Allies gain 15% increased Attack Speed while standing in the blood pool.

rupture-gore.d: Rupture now causes an explosion when you rip your weapon out, dealing 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

rupture-all-for-one.d: Casting Rupture Summons 2 Ancients that skewer your target for 20% damage and then performing a rip attack that deals 140% as direct damage instead of Bleeding.

rupture-damage-bonus.d: Rupture deals 25%[x] increased damage. Each subsequent enemy Hit reduces this bonus by 5%.

rupture-cooldown-reduction.d: Ripping your weapon out of enemies reduces Rupture's Cooldown by 1 second.

rupture-healing.d: Heal for 22% of your Maximum Life on Hit.

rend-scorching.d:
Rend now deals Fire damage.

Each slash creates a wave of fire, dealing 44% damage and an additional [4575-7079]% Burning damage over [24.6-30.6] seconds.

rend-blood-sworn.d: Enemies that die while Bleeding from Rend spread 50% their remaining Bleed onto a random Close enemy.

rend-flailing.d: Rend gains 40%[+] increased Size and 40%[x] increased damage. Consecutive swings of Rend further increases its Size by 20%[+], up to 60%[+], until you stop swinging.

rend-healing.d: Heal for 1% of your Maximum Life per second for each enemy Bleeding from Rend.

rend-moving-damage-bonus.d: Rend deals 25%[x] increased damage to enemies that are moving.

rend-vulnerable-damage-bonus.d: Rend deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

rallying-cry-booming.d: Rallying Cry increases your Resource Generation by 40%[x] and your Movement Speed by an additional 10%[x].

rallying-cry-madawc.d: Rallying Cry's Fury Cost is reduced by 10 and it now Summons Madawc who upheaves the ground, dealing 100% damage.

rallying-cry-the-world.d:
Rallying Cry Dazes and Slows all enemies and their projectiles by 61% for 4 seconds.

Rallying Cry also grants Attack Speed instead of Movement Speed and its Fury Cost is replaced with a 25 second Cooldown.

rallying-cry-duration-bonus.d: Rallying Cry's duration is increased to 7 seconds.

rallying-cry-fortify.d: Rallying Cry Fortifies you for 15% of your Maximum Life when cast.

rallying-cry-fury-gain.d: For every 3 meter traveled while Rallying Cry is active, restore 2 primary resource to yourself and half to nearby allies.

rallying-cry-potency.d: Rallying Cry's effectiveness is increased by 20% plus an additional 5% for each ally affected, up to 20%.

steel-grasp-chain-whip.d: Steel Grasp is also a Brawling Skill that launches 2 additional chains for 65% damage.

steel-grasp-devils-chain.d: Steel Grasp gains 2 additional Charges and forms 3 Dust Devils dealing 25% damage.

steel-grasp-solo-chain.d: Steel Grasp becomes a Basic Skill that has no Cooldown, generates up to 15 Fury based on Charges, but only throws a single chain.

steel-grasp-berserking.d: Steel Grasp grants Berserking for 2 seconds on Hit.

steel-grasp-weaken.d: Steel Grasp Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

steel-grasp-vulnerable.d: Steel Grasp makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

leap-death-from-above.d: Leap's Size and damage are increased the further you Leap, up to 30% increased Size and 96% damage.

leap-earthshatter.d:
Leap now deals 19% damage and can be Cast again within 2 seconds before the Cooldown begins.

Landing creates an Earthquake that deals 77% Physical damage over 4 seconds.

leap-mosh.d: Leap Summons 3 Ancients that Leap at a random enemy and deal 14% damage.

leap-arsenal-bonus.d:
Leap grants a bonus based on its Arsenal Selection
- **Dual Wield:** 2 seconds of Berserking
- **Bludgeoning:** 1 stack of Overpower
- **Slashing:** 1 stack of Ferocity

leap-pull.d: Leap now Pulls In enemies upon landing.

leap-damage-bonus-and-crowd-control.n: Leap: Damage Bonus and Crowd Control

hammer-of-the-ancients-critical-strike.n: Hammer of the Ancients: Critical Strike

Hammer of the Ancients gains 2%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for every 20 Maximum Fury you have, up to 20%[+] Critical Strike Chance at 200 Maximum Fury.

Current bonus: 0%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance.

Lunging Strike has increased range, damages all enemies in its path, and can lunge without a target.

lunging-strike-skewer.d: Lunging Strike deals 75%[x] increased damage and an additional 5%[x] increased damage for each target you lunge through, up to 100%[x].

lunging-strike-range.d: Lunging Strike's range is increased by 2.

Lunging Strike grants Berserking for 3 seconds when it Critically Strikes.

kick-madness.d:
You dash towards your enemy and deliver a powerful kick that deals 175% and Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds.

frenzy-raging.d:

Each attack gains an additional effect:
- Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a Earthquake that deals 75% Physical damage over 4 seconds,
- Two-Handed Slashing shoots Iron Shrapnel dealing 8% damage inflicting 75% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds
- Dual Wield forms Dust Devils that each deal 13% damage.

iron-maelstrom-cooldown-reduction.d: Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of Iron Maelstrom is by 2 second.

iron-maelstrom-global-cooldown-reduction.d: Activating Iron Maelstrom reduces all other active Cooldowns by 2 seconds.

iron-maelstrom-weaken.d: Enemies damaged by Iron Maelstrom Weakened for 4 seconds.

iron-maelstrom-additional-effect.d:
Each attack gains an additional effect:
- Two Handed Bludgeoning deals 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage
- Two Handed Slashing deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.
- Dual Wield gains 20%[+] Cast Speed.

Depending on your last used weapon, you summon 1 very strong Ancient for twice as long.

**Korlic:** You gain 10 Fury each time Korlic damages an enemy with his Frenzy.
**Talic:** Enemies are Slowed by 50% for 1 second when damaged by his Whirlwind.
**Madawc:** 30% chance to Stun enemies for 3 seconds when using his Upheaval.

Your Ancients are empowered:
- Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals 99% Physical damage over 4 seconds when he leaps.
- Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal 72% damage while he whirlwinds.
- Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional 0% damage over 4 seconds when he upheaves the ground.

wrath-of-the-berserker-maximum-carnage.d: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, every 200 Fury spent increases its duration by 1 second, up to 5.

mighty-throw-spares.d: Mighty Throw hurls another 2 weapons, dealing 137% damage upon impact, and pulses for 65% damage.

mighty-throw-rapid.d: Swapping weapons near any of Mighty Throw's thrown weapons creates an additional pulse for 50% damage.

**Active:** Vines strangle all enemies surrounding you, Immobilizing them for 2 seconds and Poisoning them for 180% damage over 2 seconds.

wind-shear.d: Conjure a piercing blade of wind, dealing 60% damage to enemies hit.

petrify.d: Encase all Nearby enemies in stone, Stunning them for ? seconds. Petrified enemies take 15.36%[x] bonus Critical Strike Damage from you.

rabies.d:

Infected enemies spread Rabies to other surrounding targets.

trample.d: Shapeshift and charge forward, dealing 75% damage and Knocking Back enemies.

wolves.d:
**Passive:** Summon 2 wolf companions that bite enemies for 14% damage.

**Active:** Command your wolves to use their Feral Dash ability, instantly lunging at the target dealing 200% damage and becoming Unstoppable.

cyclone-armor.d:
**Passive:** Powerful winds surround you, granting a 19.8% bonus to All Resistances.

**Active:** The winds rapidly expand, Knocking Back enemies and dealing 30% damage.

ravens.d:
**Passive**: Summon 1 Ravens to fly above you, attacking enemies for 90% damage every 5 seconds.

**Active**: The target area is swarmed with ravens, dealing 300% damage over ? seconds.

shred.d:
Shapeshift into a Werewolf and perform a trio of combo attacks:
- **1st Attack:** Deal 100% damage.
- **2nd Attack:** Deal 150% damage.

skeleton-mage.d: Raise a skeletal mage, up to a maximum of 3 mages. Skeletal mages deal 80% damage with each attack.

skeleton-warrior.d:
**Passive:** Raise a skeletal warrior from a nearby Corpse every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 warriors. Skeletal warriors deal 65% with each attack.

**Active:** Command your skeletal warriors to leap at an enemy and attack.

golem.d:
**Passive:** Raise a Golem that attacks for 125% damage. When your Golem dies, it respawns after 10 seconds.

**Active:** Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable, Taunts Nearby enemies, and takes 30% reduced damage for the next 6 seconds. It gains 50% of its Armor as Thorns for the duration.

bone-splinters-vulnerable.d: Bone Splinters makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

bone-splinters-resolve.d: Bone Splinters grants 1 stack of Resolve.

bone-splinters-bouncing-spines.d: Bone Splinters now deals 45% damage with each splinter, bounces off walls, and travels further.

bone-splinters-bloody-splinter.d:
Bone Splinters becomes a Blood Skill that deals 30% damage and pierces 1 time.

Each time a splinter hits an enemy you Heal for 2.0% of your Maximum Life.

bone-splinters-shadow-seekers.d:
Bone Splinters becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 30% Shadow damage and seeks enemies.

When a splinter hits an enemy it causes a burst of shadow, dealing an additional 8% damage.

hemorrhage-cast-speed.d: Hemorrhage gains an additional 20%[+] Cast Speed.

hemorrhage-blood-orb.d: Hemorrhage has an additional 30% chance to form a Blood Orb.

hemorrhage-blood-boil.d: Hemorrhage also deals 40% damage to enemies around your target.

hemorrhage-blood-runs-cold.d:
Hemorrhage deals 80% Cold damage and Freezes enemies for 3 seconds. An enemy can be Frozen this way once every 6 seconds.

If Hemorrhage hits an enemy already Frozen, it has an additional 50% chance to form a Blood Orb.

hemorrhage-soul-rip.d:
Hemorrhage becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 80% Shadow damage.

Instead of forming a Blood Orb, Hemorrhage Summons a Volatile Skeleton that deals 120% damage.

reap-corpse-generation.d: Reap forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.

reap-essence-generation.d: Reap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

reap-critical-strike-chance.d: Reap gains an additional 10%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

reap-chilled-to-the-bone.d:
Reap deals 50% Cold damage and Chills for 15%.

Reap gains an additional 30%[+] Cast Speed.

reap-cull-the-weak.d:
Reap becomes a Blood Skill that deals 63% Physical damage.

Reap will Execute enemies and has a 50% chance to form a Blood Orb if they are killed by it.

reap-harvest.d: Reap sweeps a second time, dealing 25% damage and generating 7.5 Essence.

bone-spirit-maximum-essence.d: Each enemy hit by Bone Spirit increases your Maximum Essence by 2 for 15 seconds, up to 20 Essence.

bone-spirit-damage-bonus.d: Every second, your next Bone Spirit deals 10%[x] increased damage, up to 30%[x].

bone-spirit-charges.d: Bone Spirit gains 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

bone-spirit-core-skill.d:
Bone Spirit becomes a Core Skill, costs 30 Essence, and no longer has a Cooldown.

Bone Spirit will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast, dealing 3%[x] increased damage for each point of Essence consumed.

bone-spirit-astral-projection.d: Bone Spirit no longer seeks enemies and instead spirals around you, piercing through enemies and exploding for 100% damage when it hits them.

bone-spirit-unfinished-business.d:
Bone Spirit becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Bone Spirit leaves behind a pool of Desecrated Ground when it explodes, dealing 250% Corrupting damage.

bone-spirit-poltergeists.d: When Bone Spirit explodes, it spawns 3 smaller spirits that seek enemies and explode for 30% damage each.

decompose-barrier.d: Decompose grants a Barrier every second for 10% of your Maximum Life that lasts 6 seconds.

decompose-lucky-hit-chance.d: Decompose has an additional 30%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

decompose-rip-and-tear.d:
Decompose becomes a Bone Skill that deals Physical damage.

Decompose now hits all other enemies in between you and the primary target.

decompose-putrid-burst.d: Decompose causes a burst around the target every second, dealing an additional 113% damage to them and nearby enemies.

corpse-explosion-blood-orb.d: Corpse Explosion has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

corpse-explosion-corpse-efficiency.d: Corpses consumed by Corpse Explosion can be consumed 1 additional time.

corpse-explosion-bloody-mess.d: Corpse Explosion's Size is increased by 50% and damage is increased by 75%[x].

corpse-explosion-miasma.d: Corpse Explosion is also a Darkness Skill and, instead of exploding, releases a vile miasma dealing 350% Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.

corpse-explosion-shrapnel.d: Corpse Explosion is also a Bone Skill and, instead of exploding, fires 8 piercing bone shards dealing 180% damage each.

corpse-explosion-multiple-corpses.d: Corpse Explosion detonates up to 2 additional corpses.

blood-lance-overpower.d: Blood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.

blood-lance-cost-reduction.d: Blood Lance's Essence cost is reduced by 3.

blood-lance-fortify.d: Blood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life if it hits an enemy already lanced.

blood-lance-ricochet.d: Blood Lance ricochets to 1 additional enemy.

blood-lance-festering-wound.d:
Blood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage.

Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 100% Corrupting damage per second to them.

blood-lance-gore-quills.d:
Every 3rd cast of Blood Lance forms a Blood Orb under the first enemy hit.

Casting Blood Lance will pick up a Blood Orb around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing 125% of normal damage.

blood-lance-blood-seeker.d: Blood Lance deals 50%[x] increased damage per lanced enemy, and an additional 50%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

blood-surge-overpower.d: Blood Surge consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to gain 25% increased Size and 50%[x] increased damage.

blood-surge-weaken.d: Blood Surge Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

blood-surge-pins-and-needles.d:
Blood Surge becomes a Bone Skill and, instead of expelling a blood nova, expels 10 piercing bone shards dealing 60% damage each.

Instead of dealing increased damage, Blood Surge expels 1 additional shard for each enemy drawn from, up to 5 additional shards.

blood-surge-you-and-what-army.n: Blood Surge: You And What Army?
blood-surge-you-and-what-army.d:
Blood Surge expels smaller blood novas on your Minions, dealing 20% damage.

Blood Surge's minion nova damage is increased by 5%[x] for each enemy drawn from, up to 50%[x].

blood-surge-bloodbath.d: Blood Surge's nova echoes again after a short delay, dealing 125% damage.

blood-surge-fortify.d: Blood Surge Fortifies you for 2% of your Maximum Life for each enemy drawn from, up to 10%.

blood-surge-damage-bonus.d: Blood Surge deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

bone-spear-pierce-damage-bonus.d: Bone Spear deals 10%[x] increased damage per enemy pierced, up to 50%[x].

bone-spear-resolve.d: Bone Spear deals 5%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage per stack of Resolve, up to 40%[x].

bone-spear-shadow-splitter.d:
Bone Spear becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 200% Shadow damage.

Instead of piercing through, Bone Spear forks into 2 piercing spears each time it hits an enemy or wall, up to 2 times.

bone-spear-blood-spear.d:
Bone Spear becomes a Blood Skill that deals 160% damage.

Casting Bone Spear consumes a nearby Corpse and conjures a second Bone Spear from it, dealing 100% of normal damage.

bone-spear-bone-spikes.d: Bone Spear breaks into 3 piercing bone shards when it is destroyed, dealing 53% damage each.

bone-spear-first-hit-damage-bonus.n: Bone Spear: First Hit Damage Bonus
bone-spear-first-hit-damage-bonus.d: Bone Spear deals 40%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

bone-spear-cost-reduction.d: Bone Spear's Essence cost is reduced by 5.

blight-crowd-control-damage-bonus.d: Blight deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

blight-lucky-hit-chance.d: Blight has an additional 20%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

blight-volatile-blood.d:
Blight becomes a Blood skill that deals Physical damage.

Blight's defiled area instantly bursts, dealing 315% damage.

blight-whirlpool.d:
Blight deals Cold and Frostbite damage and its Essence Cost is reduced by 10.

Its defiled area Pulls in enemies and Chills for 15% every second.

blight-piercing-darkness.d: Blight pierces 1 time and can spawn an additional defiled area. Blight deals 75%[x] increased damage to Bosses.

blight-area-damage-bonus.d: Blight's defiled area deals 40%[x] increased damage.

sever-damage-bonus.d: Sever deals 10%[x] increased damage, and an additional 1%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

sever-cost-reduction.d: Sever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.

sever-reaping-lotus.d: Sever sends out 3 additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing 60% damage each.

sever-inexorable-reaper.d: Sever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.

sever-cold-pursuit.d: Sever deals Cold damage, Chills for 15%, and seeks another enemy to attack again.

sever-crowd-control-and-corpse-generatio.n: Sever: Crowd Control and Corpse Generation
sever-crowd-control-and-corpse-generatio.d: Sever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.

sever-ferocity.d: Sever deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

blood-mist-critical-strike.d: Blood Mist grants 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance for 5 seconds after it ends.

blood-mist-movement-speed.d: Blood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.

blood-mist-blood-transfusion.d: Blood Mist Fortifies you for 30% of your Maximum Life over its duration and forms a Blood Orb every second.

blood-mist-blood-rush.d:
Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

blood-mist-devouring-mist.d:
Blood Mist becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Blood Mist now deals 600% Shadow damage over its duration and applies Vampiric Curse to enemies.

blood-mist-overpower.d: Blood Mist grants 1 stack of Overpower every second.

blood-mist-vulnerable-and-slow.d: Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

bone-prison-cooldown-reduction.d: Bone Prison reduces your active Cooldowns by 0.5 seconds for each enemy trapped, up to 5 seconds.

bone-prison-essence-generation.d: Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.

bone-prison-bramble.d:
You gain [X] Thorns for each enemy trapped by Bone Prison.

When a segment of Bone Prison is destroyed or expires, it deals 100% of your Thorns around itself.

bone-prison-plunging-darkness.d:
Bone Prison becomes a Darkness Skill.

Bone Prison forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of Desecrated Ground, dealing 450% Corrupting damage.

bone-prison-life-imprisonment.d:
Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you.

While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.

bone-prison-vulnerable.d: Bone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

bone-prison-resolve.d: Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

iron-maiden-ferocity-and-overpower.d: **Lucky Hit:** Enemies hit while afflicted with Iron Maiden have up to a 15% chance to randomly grant 1 stack of Ferocity or Overpower.

iron-maiden-vulnerable.d: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden are Vulnerable.

iron-maiden-blood-maiden.d:
Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for 150% damage.

iron-maiden-torture-artist.d:
Iron Maiden is also a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Enemies have 30% chance to be stunned for 2 seconds when they take damage from Iron Maiden.

iron-maiden-schadenfreude.d:
While at least 1 enemy is afflicted with Iron Maiden, you gain [X] Thorns.

Iron Maiden's damage is increased by 100% of your Thorns.

iron-maiden-execute-and-fortify.d:
Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed.

You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.

iron-maiden-essence-generation.d: Iron Maiden no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates 5 Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with Iron Maiden.

decrepify-resolve.d: **Lucky Hit:** Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.

decrepify-movement-speed.d: Each enemy afflicted with Decrepify increases your Movement Speed by 2%[x].

decrepify-unholy-frenzy.d: Instead of afflicting enemies Decrepify is now applied to your Minions, granting them 20%[x] increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.

decrepify-life-tap.d:
Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for 10 of your Maximum Life whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second.

Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

decrepify-dizzying-curse.d: The first time an enemy is afflicted with Decrepify they are Dazed for 3.0 seconds.

decrepify-cooldown-reduction.d: **Lucky Hit:** Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

decrepify-critical-strike-chance.d: You have an additional 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies afflicted with Decrepify.

corpse-tendrils-critical-strike-chance.d: You gain an additional 5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.

corpse-tendrils-bitter-harvest.d: Corpse Tendrils no longer consumes the Corpse. Enemies are Immobilized for 3 seconds after being Pulled in.

corpse-tendrils-get-over-here.d:
Corpse Tendrils is no longer cast on a Corpse and is cast on you instead.

Corpse Tendrils Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life for each enemy it damages.

corpse-tendrils-jaws-of-death.d: Corpse Tendrils now deals 100% damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.

corpse-tendrils-vulnerable.d: Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

corpse-tendrils-lucky-hit-chance.d: Corpse Tendrils gains an additional 40%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

blood-wave-overpower.d: Casting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.

blood-wave-blood-orb.d: Blood Wave forms up to 2 Blood Orbs as it travels.

blood-wave-hematolagnia.d:
Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 70 Essence.

Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

blood-wave-path-of-darkness.d:
Blood Wave becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Blood Wave leaves behind a trail of Desecrated Ground as it travels that deals 800% Corrupting damage.

blood-wave-tides-of-blood.d: Blood Wave launches 1 additional wave, dealing 500% damage.

blood-wave-damage-reduction.d: Casting Blood Wave grants 10% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.

blood-wave-damage-bonus.d: Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.

soulrift-movement-speed.d:
While Soulrift is active you are Unhindered and gain 1%[+] increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to 40%[+].

This bonus persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

soulrift-barrier.d:
Every soul absorbed by Soulrift grants a Barrier for 0.5 of your Maximum Life.

This Barrier persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

soulrift-distilled-anima.d: While Soulrift is active, your Darkness damage is increased by 30%[x].

soulrift-soul-vortex.d: Soulrift is cast at the target location and its Cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals 25% damage and Pulls them in.

soulrift-frozen-wasteland.d:
Soulrift deals Frostbite damage and Chills for 30% every second.

If Soulrift absorbs the soul of a Frozen enemy, they shatter and explode for 75% damage.

soulrift-vulnerable-and-crowd-control.d:
When Soulrift absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

After Soulrift ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by 85% for 5 seconds.

soulrift-ferocity.d: Every 30 souls absorbed by Soulrift grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

bone-storm-damage-reduction.d: Bone Storm increases your Damage Reduction by 10%.

bone-storm-duration-increase.d: Bone Storm consumes up to 4 corpses to increase its duration by 2 seconds per corpse.

bone-storm-roll-the-bones.d: Bone Storm increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by 15%[+].

bone-storm-shadow-and-bone.d:
Bone Storm becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional 40% Corrupting damage over 2 seconds.

bone-storm-hungry-cyclone.d: Bone Storm is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

bone-storm-vulnerable.d: Bone Storm makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

bone-storm-barrier.d: Casting Bone Storm grants a Barrier for 50% of your Maximum Life for 10 seconds.

army-of-the-dead-damage-bonus.n: Army of the Dead: Damage Bonus
army-of-the-dead-damage-bonus.d: Army of the Dead deals 2%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

army-of-the-dead-cooldown-reduction.n: Army of the Dead: Cooldown Reduction
army-of-the-dead-cooldown-reduction.d: Army of the Dead's Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

army-of-the-dead-dead-cold.n: Army of the Dead: Dead Cold
army-of-the-dead-dead-cold.d: Army of the Dead now deals 150% Cold damage and Freezes enemies instead of Stunning them.

army-of-the-dead-pile-the-bodies.n: Army of the Dead: Pile the Bodies
army-of-the-dead-pile-the-bodies.d: Army of the Dead will converge on your target. Each time a Volatile Skeleton explodes on an enemy, they take 10%[x] increased damage from your Army of the Dead, up to 300%[x].

army-of-the-dead-unyielding-commander.n: Army of the Dead: Unyielding Commander
army-of-the-dead-unyielding-commander.d: While Army of the Dead is active, your Minions take 90% reduced damage and deal 30%[x] increased damage.

army-of-the-dead-passive-bonus.n: Army of the Dead: Passive Bonus
army-of-the-dead-passive-bonus.d: Army of the Dead passively summons a Volatile Skeleton every 4 seconds.

army-of-the-dead-corpse-generation.n: Army of the Dead: Corpse Generation
army-of-the-dead-corpse-generation.d: Army of the Dead has a 50% chance to form a Corpse.

skeleton-mage-duration-damage-bonus.d: Skeleton Mages deal 15%[x] increased damage. This bonus increases by 1% every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to 25%[x].

skeleton-mage-critical-strike-chance.d: You gain an additional 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by Skeleton Mages.

skeleton-mage-coven.d: Skeleton Mage's maximum number of mages is increased by 2.

skeleton-mage-gift-of-death.d:
Skeleton Mage is also a Corpse Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised.

Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by 50%[x].

skeleton-mage-singularity.d:
Skeleton Mage will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage.

The skeletal mage deals 3%[x] increased damage and lasts for 0.1 seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

skeleton-mage-crowd-control-damage-bonus.n: Skeleton Mage: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
skeleton-mage-crowd-control-damage-bonus.d: Skeleton Mages deal 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

skeleton-mage-ferocity-resolve-or-overpo.n: Skeleton Mage: Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower
skeleton-mage-ferocity-resolve-or-overpo.d: Skeleton Mages have a 5% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower whenever they attack based on whether your Skeleton Mage type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.

skeleton-warrior-damage-bonus.d: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors causes them to deal 25%[x] increased damage for 10 seconds.

skeleton-warrior-healing.d: Skeleton Warriors heal you for 2% of your Maximum Life whenever they attack.

skeleton-warrior-master-of-puppets.d: Skeleton Warrior's maximum number of warriors is increased by 3.

skeleton-warrior-service-and-sacrifice.d:
Skeleton Warriors lose 25% of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing 150% damage.

Skeleton Warriors are now raised from a nearby Corpse every 0.5 seconds.

skeleton-warrior-litany-of-death.d:
If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, Skeleton Warrior briefly Summons a Skeleton Priest instead.

Skeleton Priest empowers your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by 15%[+] and healing them for 100% of their Maximum Life over the duration.

skeleton-warrior-vulnerable.d: Skeleton Warriors have a 30% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

skeleton-warrior-resolve.d: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors grants 3 stacks of Resolve.

golem-damage-bonus.d: Golem deals 30%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

golem-unstoppable.d: Commanding your Golem also grants you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

golem-gargantua.d: Golem now raises a larger Golem that gains an aura of command, increasing the Cast Speed and Movement Speed of your other Minions by 20%[x].

golem-fel-gluttony.d:
Commanding your Golem causes it to erupt, dealing 300% damage to surrounding enemies.

Your Golem passively consumes nearby Corpses every second to reduce its Cooldown by 2 seconds per Corpse consumed.

golem-gravebloom.d: Golem now raises 3 smaller Golems that deal 60% of normal damage and gain 30%[+] Attack Speed.

golem-weaken.d: Golem Weakens enemies for 4 seconds whenever it attacks.

golem-resolve-overpower-or-ferocity.d: Commanding your Golem grants 3 stacks of Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity based on whether your Golem type is Bone, Blood, or Iron respectively.

falling-star.d: Soar into the air with angelic wings and dive onto the battlefield, dealing 80% damage on takeoff and 240% damage on landing.

defiance-aura.d:
**Passive:** Your presence reinforces you and your allies, granting 50% Armor and 50% bonus on All Resistances.

**Active:** You become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

blessed-hammer.d: Throw a Blessed Hammer that spirals out, dealing 115% damage.

shield-charge-v2.d: Charge with your shield and push enemies Back, granting 60%[+] Armor and dealing 180% damage while Channeling.

zeal.d: Strike enemies with blinding speed, dealing 80% damage followed immediately by 3 additional strikes dealing 35% damage each.

holy-light-aura.d:
**Passive:** You and your allies emanate the Light, dealing 45% damage every 2 seconds to 3 random Nearby enemies. Attack Speed further increases this damage.

**Active:** Unleash 2 pure bolts of light, dealing 320% Holy damage to the Closest enemy and chaining up to 4 additional enemies before returning to you. When your first bolt of light returns, Heal for 12% of your Maximum Life.

clash.d:
Strike an enemy with your weapon and shield, dealing 115% damage.

Striking enemies with Clash grants you Crusader's March, increasing your Block Chance by 30%[+] for 6 seconds.

blessed-shield.d: Bless and hurl your shield with Holy energy, dealing 216% damage that ricochets up to 3 times.

rally.d: Rally forth, generating 16 Faith and gaining 15%[+] Movement Speed for 6 seconds.

fanaticism-aura.d:
**Passive:** Spending Faith emanates power from you, granting you and your allies 5.0%[+] Attack Speed and 2.0%[+] Critical Strike Chance for 3 seconds up to a maximum of 4 times.

**Active:** Weaken all Nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

shield-bash.d: Charge at an enemy and bash in front of you, dealing 205% damage.

holy-bolt.d: Throw a Holy hammer, dealing 90% damage.

divine-lance.d: Impale enemies with a heavenly lance, stabbing 2 times for 110% damage each.

aegis.d: Surround yourself with shields of the Light, Taunting Close enemies and gaining 30% Block Chance and 30% Armor for 4 seconds.

brandish.d: Brandish the Light, unleashing an arc that deals 75% damage.

advance.d: Advance forward with your weapon, dealing 105% damage.

consecration.d: Bathe in the Light for 6 seconds, Healing you and your allies for 4.0% Maximum Life per second and damaging enemies for 75% damage per second.

heavens-fury.d: Grasp the Light, dealing 200% damage around you per second before releasing it to seek Nearby enemies and dealing 60% damage per hit for 7 seconds.

zenith.d:
Summon a divine sword that cleaves the battlefield for 550% damage.

Casting Zenith again cuts through the battlefield for 500% damage and Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds.

fortress.d:
Make your stand, becoming Immune for 3.0 seconds and create a defensive area around you for 8.0 seconds.

Standing in your Fortress grants you and your allies 2 Resolve stacks every 0.5 seconds.

arbiter-of-justice.d: Ascend to the heavens and crash upon the battlefield as an Arbiter for 20.0 seconds, dealing 600% damage upon landing.

condemn.d:
Harness the Light and Pull enemies in after 1.5 seconds, briefly Stunning them and dealing 240% damage.

While Casting Condemn, you become Unhindered for 1.5 seconds.

spear-of-the-heavens.d: Rain down 4 heavenly spears from the sky, dealing 160% damage and Knocking Down enemies for 1.5 seconds. After 1.5 seconds, the spears burst, dealing 120% damage.

purify.d: Enshroud your enemies in the Light, Dazing them for 2 seconds.

falling-star-damage.d: Falling Star deals 20%[x] increased damage if it is cast again within 15 seconds.

falling-star-cooldown-reduction.d: Killing a Vulnerable enemy reduces the Cooldown of Falling Star by 0.5 seconds.

falling-star-starfall.d: When landing, Falling Star deals 105% damage and erupts 3 additional times.

falling-star-fanatic-descent.d: Falling Star becomes a Zealot skill, now dealing 560% damage on landing and Weakening enemies hit for 4 seconds.

falling-star-faster-than-light.d: Falling Star cuts through the battlefield, Knocking Down enemies for 2 seconds when landing and creating a fissure along your path that deals 180% damage before erupting for 60% damage.

falling-star-vulnerable.d: Falling Star applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds on landing.

defiance-aura-potency.d: Defiance Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.

defiance-aura-bonus-healing.d: Defiance Aura grants you and your allies 25% Healing received.

defiance-aura-rite-of-thorns.d:
Defiance Aura's passive also grants [X] Thorns and increases you and your allies' Thorns by 75%[+].

Defiance Aura's active instead releases a nova dealing 500%[x] of your Thorns damage.

defiance-aura-rite-of-prayer.d:
Defiance Aura's passive also Heals you and your allies for 2.0% of your Maximum Life per second.

Healing yourself and allies grants 2 stacks of Resolve every 1 second.

defiance-aura-rite-of-might.d: Defiance Aura's increases your damage by 10.0%[x] for 4 seconds whenever you gain Resolve.

defiance-aura-maximum-life.d: Defiance Aura's passive also grants you and your allies 15% Maximum Life.

holy-light-aura-rite-of-mercy.d: Holy Light's active chains 2 more times and Fortifies you and your allies for 4.0% of their Maximum Life.

When Shield Charge ends you release a Holy nova, dealing 180% damage and Stunning enemies for 3 seconds.

Shield Charge becomes a Core Skill that deals 216% damage.

aegis-unstoppable.d: Casting Aegis grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

Aegis now applies Judgement instead of Taunting enemies.

Blocking while Aegis is active applies Judgement to the attacker.

shield-bash-damage-bonus.d: Shield Bash deals 100%[x] more damage to its primary target.

divine-lance-cast-speed.d: Divine Lance gains 20%[+] increased Cast Speed.

Divine Lance flurries, stabbing 2 additional times and deals 39% damage each.

Killing Vulnerable enemies with Divine Lance increases its Attack Speed by 5% for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

divine-lance-zealous-joust.d:
Divine Lance becomes a Zealot Skill.

Divine Lance now stabs with 2 additional spears in a wider area, dealing 83% damage each and has 10%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

divine-lance-divine-javelin.d:
Throw Divine Lance, dealing 110% damage to the first enemy hit and bursting for an additional 550% damage.

The first time an enemy is hit by a Divine Lance, they are impaled and dragged with it.

divine-lance-damage-bonus.d:
Divine Lance deals 15%[x] increased damage.

Double this bonus against Vulnerable enemies.

blessed-shield-damage-bonus.d: Blessed Shield deals 75% of your shield's Block Chance as additional damage.

Blessed Shield detonates Judgement and ricochets 5 additional times.

Whenever Blessed Shield detonates Judgement, it empowers your next throw to deal 40%[x] increased damage, up to a maximum of 5 times and it increases your Judgement damage by 50%[x] for 5 seconds.

blessed-shield-shield-of-the-revenant.n: Blessed Shield: Shield of the Revenant

Blessed Shield now boomerangs and pierces instead of ricocheting, dealing 270% damage.

Hitting enemies with Blessed Shield increases its damage by 5% for 6 seconds up to 5 times.

blessed-shield-shield-of-retribution.d:
Blessed Shield becomes a Juggernaut Skill.

Blessed Shield travels straight without returning, pulsing 70% of your Thorns damage for 3 seconds before bursting for 378% damage.

blessed-shield-cast-speed.d: Blessed Shield gains 20%[+] increased Cast Speed.

blessed-shield-faith-generation.d: When Blessed Shield hits a Crowd Controlled enemy, gain 5 Faith.

zeal-zealots-legacy.d: Zeal extends its assault, randomly seeking surrounding enemies and striking 4 additional times.

zeal-death-or-glory.d:
Zeal costs 10%[x] Maximum Life instead of Faith and strikes around you in a circle.

Whenever you lose Life, Zeal's damage increases by  60% and Critical Strike Chance by 20% for 6 seconds.

zeal-cull-the-wicked.d: Zeal's cleave is larger, gains 2 additional strikes, and deals 25%[x] increased damage to Weakened enemies.

zeal-fortify.d: Critically Striking enemies with Zeal has a 25% chance to grant 1% of Maximum Life as Fortify.

zeal-critical-strike-chance.d:
Zeal has an additional 6%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

Double this bonus against Weakened enemies.

fanaticism-aura-extra-passive-stack.d: Fanaticism Aura's passive stacks 1 additional time.

fanaticism-aura-additional-maximum-resou.d: Fanaticism Aura's passive also grants you and your allies 15% Maximum Resource.

fanaticism-aura-rite-of-redemption.d: Weakened enemies who die within Fanaticism Aura's radius Heal you for 0.5% and Fortify for 1.0% of your Maximum Life.

fanaticism-aura-rite-of-humility.d:
Fanaticism Aura's active instead makes Nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Damaging Vulnerable enemies will also trigger Fanaticism's Passive.

fanaticism-aura-rite-of-vengeance.d:
Fanaticism Aura Passive increases Critical Strike Damage by 6.0%[x] for you and your allies.

Critical Strikes trigger Fanaticism's Passive.

fanaticism-aura-potency.d: Fanaticism Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.

fanaticism-aura-resource-generation.d: Fanaticism Aura increases Resource Generation for you and your allies by 25%.

holy-bolt-ricocheting-bolt.d: Holy Bolt deals 135% damage and ricochets 3 times.

Holy Bolt becomes a Disciple Skill.

Holy Bolt pierces, deals 120% damage, and applies Vulnerable.

holy-bolt-storm-bolt.d:
Holy Bolt becomes a Justice Skill with a 7 second Cooldown.

Holy Bolt is hurled and smashes the ground, dealing 315% damage and Stunning enemies in an area for 2 seconds.

holy-bolt-cast-speed.d:
Increase Holy Bolt's Cast Speed by 10%[+] when hitting an enemy for 4 seconds, up to 30%[+].

Decrease Holy Bolt's Cooldown by 30%.

holy-bolt-slow.d: Holy Bolt Slows enemies by 50% for 5 seconds.

holy-bolt-faith-generation.d: Holy Bolt generates an additional 7 Faith.

rally-words-of-rejuvenation.d: Rally generates 20 more Faith and gains 1 additional Charge.

rally-words-of-inspiration.d: Rally spends all available Charges, reducing all active Justice Skill Cooldowns by 3 seconds per Charge.

rally-words-of-sacrifice.d: Rally now costs 35% of your Maximum Life and can stack up to 3 times.

rally-critical-strike-chance.d: Casting Rally increases your Critical Strike Chance by 5%[+] while active.

rally-cost-reduction.d: Rally's Cooldown and Costs are reduced by 15%.

brandish-cross-strike.d: Brandish unleashes 2 additional arcs, dealing 120% damage.

brandish-sword-of-mastery.d: While Healthy, Brandish deals 128% damage and travels 100% faster.

brandish-returning-light.d: Brandish's light returns to you, dealing 53% damage on its return.

brandish-vulnerable.d: Brandish applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds.

clash-seize-them.d:
Your Resolve empowers Clash, dealing 8%[x] increased damage per stack of Resolve, up to 16 stacks.

Every 3rd strike, enemies are Pulled in.

clash-skirmish.d:
Clash becomes a Zealot Skill and cleaves in an area for 155% damage.

You are emboldened during Crusader's March, granting:

- [X] Thorns
- 20%[x] Thorns damage

clash-crusaders-march-effectiveness.d: Increase the effect of Crusader's March by 25%[x]

Advance becomes a Disciple Skill and has a 10 second cooldown.

advance-wave-dash.d:
Advance becomes a Juggernaut Skill.

Advance's impact waves out, dealing 137% damage and gains 1 Resolve for every 1 meter you dash.

advance-vanguards-rush.d: Advance rushes into enemies, granting 1 Fervor on each strike and deals an additional 25%[x] damage per stack of Fervor you have.

advance-unhindered.d: Casting Advance grants you Unhindered for 2 seconds.

advance-critical-strike-chance.d: Advance grants 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance for 8 seconds.

arbiter-of-justice-cooldown-reduction.d: Reduce Arbiter of Justice's Cooldown by 20 seconds.

arbiter-of-justice-wing-strike-recast.d: Arbiter form's Wing Strikes recast time is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Arbiter form gains the following benefits:

- Wing Strikes deal 200%[x] increased damage
- Wing Strikes apply Vulnerable

arbiter-of-justice-reach-of-the-law.n: Arbiter of Justice: Reach of the Law

Arbiter of Justice ascends for an additional 2 seconds and rains Blessed Spears on the battlefield.

Upon landing, Arbiter of Justice bombards the battlefield with 10 additional Blessed Spears, applying Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

zenith-weaken.d: Killing Weakened enemies with Zenith reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds.

Zenith is now also a Mobility Skill that:
- Dashes to enemies
- Gains 25%[x] Critical Strike Damage

Zenith sunders a rift in the ground with a single strike, Knocking Down enemies and dealing 1100% damage.

After 0.75 second, the rift detonates for 825% damage.

Zenith unleashes your wrath, dealing 193% damage and can be cast indefinitely for 4 seconds before starting its Cooldown.

Instead of Knocking Down enemies, Zenith's 2nd strike extends this duration by 0.5 second.

While inside of Fortress your Life cannot be reduced below 1.

Fortress duration is reduced by 50%.

Killing enemies inside of your Fortress extends its duration by 0.5 seconds up to 20 seconds.

You may recast Fortress to move it to your current location.

heavens-fury-duration.d: Increase Heaven's Fury duration by 4 seconds.

heavens-fury-slow.d: Heaven's Fury Slows enemies by 50% for 5 seconds.

heavens-fury-final-justice.d:
Heaven's Fury can Cast anywhere, concentrating the Light as it grows and Pulls enemies in while dealing 105% damage per second before erupting for 1260% damage.

Heaven's Fury's Cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

heavens-fury-triplicate.d: Heaven's Fury splits into 3 beams, dealing 57% damage each hit for 7 seconds.

condemn-shepherd-the-flock.d: Condemn's build up marks all enemies and drags them to your location after it Casts.

condemn-atonement.d: Condemn Casts significantly faster instead of Pulling enemies in, dealing 420% damage.

spear-of-the-heavens-judgement-damage-bo.d: Spear of the Heavens deals 40%[x] increased damage against enemies affected by Judgement.

spear-of-the-heavens-projectiles.d: Spear of the Heavens releases 3 additional projectiles after its 1st impact.

spear-of-the-heavens-vulnerable.d: Spear of the Heavens applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds.

spear-of-the-heavens-part-the-heavens.d: Spear of the Heavens now drops 8 spears along the path toward your target.

spear-of-the-heavens-fist-of-the-heavens.n: Spear of the Heavens: Fist of the Heavens
spear-of-the-heavens-fist-of-the-heavens.d:
Spear of the Heavens becomes a Core Skill and is now pure Holy energy that crashes down from the sky.

On impact it deals 386% damage and breaks into 5 projectiles, dealing 386% additional damage to enemies in their path.

consecration-resource-generation.d: Consecration increases Primary Resource Generation for you and your allies by 10%[+].

consecration-fortify.d: Consecration's initial Cast Fortifies you for 0.5% of Maximum Life per enemy hit.

consecration-duration.d: Increase the duration of Consecration by 35%[x].

consecration-sanctify.d:
Consecration lasts 3 seconds, increasing its damage and Healing by 20% each second.

Consecration detonates when it expires, dealing 90% damage to all enemies and Healing you and your allies for 15% of their Maximum Life.

consecration-bastion.d: Consecration Immobilizes enemies and can be cast anywhere.

consecration-hallowed-ground.d:
Consecration's size is increased by 56%

purify-faith-generation.d: Purify generates 10 Faith for each enemy it hits.

purify-size-bonus.d: Increase the size of Purify by 50%.

purify-echo.d: Purify echoes 2 additional times outward from where it is Cast.

purify-surrender.d: Instead of Dazing enemies, Purify now Stuns for 4 seconds.

purify-sentence.d: Purify also Judges enemies and its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

flurry.d: Unleash a flurry of stabs and slashes, striking enemies in front of you 4 times and dealing a total of 196% damage to each.

heartseeker.d: Fire an arrow that seeks an enemy and pierces through its heart, dealing 50% damage.

blade-shift.d: Quickly stab your victim for 45% damage and shift, making you Unhindered for 4 seconds. Moving through enemies refreshes the shift duration.

smoke-grenade.d: Throw a smoky concoction at enemies that deals 90% damage and Dazes them for 4 seconds.

barrage.d: Unleash a barrage of 5 arrows that expands outwards, each dealing 100% damage and piercing up to 2 times. Arrows cannot hit the same target more than once.

caltrops.d: Throw caltrops on the ground, dealing 60% damage. Affected enemies take 10% damage every second and are Slowed by 50%. Lasts 6 seconds.

invigorating-strike.d: Melee attack an enemy, dealing 65% damage and also gain 3 Energy once every 1.0 seconds for 4 seconds.

shadow-step.d: Quickly move through the shadows to stab your victim from behind for 80% damage and Execute them. Gain 15% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds afterwards.

cold-imbuement.d: Imbue your weapons with frigid energies for 6 seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Cold damage, Chill enemies for 25% per hit, and Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.

penetrating-shot.d: Fire an arrow that pierces through all enemies in a line, dealing 150% damage.

poison-imbuement.d: Imbue your weapons with lethal poison for 6 seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Poison damage and apply 100% of their Base damage as additional Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

puncture.d: Throw blades a short distance, dealing 45% damage.

dark-shroud.d: Surround yourself with up to 5 protective shadows. Gain 8.0 Resistance to All Elements per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by 20.0%. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.

poison-trap.d:
Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates when an enemy moves within range, applying 540% Poisoning damage over 9 seconds to enemies in the area.

You can have 4 armed traps out at once.

twisting-blades.d: Impale an enemy with your blades, dealing 42% damage. After 1.5 seconds the blades return to you, piercing enemies for 98% damage.

dash.d: Dash forward and slash enemies for 66% damage. Any enemies hit are Slowed by 30% for 4 seconds.

Imbue your weapons with festering shadows for 6 seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Shadow damage and infect enemies for 6 seconds. Infected enemies explode on death, dealing 40% damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the infection expires before the enemy dies, it will deal 60% damage to only that enemy.

rain-of-arrows.d: Arrows rain down over a large area dealing 450% damage and Immobilizing enemies for 3 seconds.

death-trap.d: Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates once an enemy is within range, dealing a total of 200% damage in the area.

rapid-fire.d: Rapidly fire 7 arrows, each dealing 30% damage and ricocheting 2 times.

concealment.d:
Vanish from sight, gaining an advanced form of Stealth for 5 seconds that will not be removed by taking damage.

Concealment also makes you Unstoppable, grants 30%[+] Movement Speed, and Unhindered for its duration.

Using an attack Skill during Concealment will break Concealment.

dance-of-knives.d: Channel to launch knives at surrounding enemies with each knife dealing 52% damage. Attack Speed increases damage done rather than number of knives thrown.

heartseeker-energy.d: Gain 3 Energy when Heartseeker hits an enemy.

flurry-encircling-blades.d: Flurry now damages enemies in a circle around you and deals 343% damage.

flurry-transporter.d:

flurry-fortify.d: Fortify for 3% of your Maximum Life when Flurry hits an enemy for the first time.

flurry-resolve.d: Casting Flurry grants 10% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds while you have Resolve.

flurry-damage-increase.d: Casting Flurry increases its damage by 15%[x], up to 45%[x]. This bonus resets after hitting the maximum.

Rapid Fire is also a Grenade Skill.

Rapid Fire fires arrows tipped with grenades, causing them to no longer ricochet and instead explode, dealing 23% damage.

rapid-fire-breakneck-quiver.d: Rapid Fire gains 50%[+] increased Cast Speed, and its Energy Cost is reduced to 15.

rapid-fire-ruckus.d: Rapid Fire deals 48% damage and ricochets to 1 additional target.

rapid-fire-critical-strike.d: Rapid Fire gains 5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance. Each subsequent arrow of Rapid Fire has 1%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance, up to 7%[+] on the 7th arrow.

rapid-fire-energy-gain.d: For each arrow, gain 1 Energy when they first hit a Vulnerable or Weakened target.

rapid-fire-ferocity.d: Rapid Fire deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

rapid-fire-additional-projectiles.d: Rapid Fire fires 1 additional arrow. Casting Rapid Fire consumes 1 stack of Overpower to fire 2 more additional arrow.

blade-shift-grenade-shift.d: Blade Shift now deals 56% damage and while Unhindered by Blade Shift, you drop 2 Stun Grenades that each deal 11% damage on the enemies you pass through.

blade-shift-impossible-escape.d: Blade Shift now deals 56% Shadow damage and moving through an enemy while Unhindered by Blade Shift automatically attacks that enemy with Blade Shift.

blade-shift-range-of-motion.d: Blade Shift's shift now lasts for 4 additional seconds and while active, grants you 15%[x] increased Movement Speed. When you move through an enemy, Blade Shift is empowered to deal 75%[x] increased damage while active.

blade-shift-resolve.d: When you move through an enemy, gain 1 stack of Resolve.

blade-shift-overpower.d: When you move through an enemy, gain 1 stack of Overpower.

blade-shift-energy.d: When you move through an enemy, gain 4 Energy.

blade-shift-resistance.d: While Blade Shift is active, gain +0 and 20.0 Resistance to All Elements.

caltrops-catch-cold.d: Caltrops now deals Cold damage and Chills enemies for 15% per second.

caltrops-pernicious-poisons.d: Throw 3 smaller Caltrops that now deal Poison damage and 105% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Enemies affected by this Poisoning are Weakened

caltrops-duration.d: Caltrops' duration is increased by 2 seconds.

caltrops-ferocity.d: Casting Caltrops grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

caltrops-critical-strike.d: You now have 3%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies inside your Caltrops. Double this amount against Vulnerable enemies.

invigorating-strike-accumulating-strike.d: Invigorating Strike now deals 114% damage and every 3rd cast grants 1 stack of Resolve and 1 stack of Ferocity.

invigorating-strike-quick-strike.d:
Invigorating Strike is also a Mobility Skill.

Casting Invigorating Strike now dashes you to the target, dealing 114% damage and granting 10%[x] increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

invigorating-strike-enervating-strike.d: Invigorating Strike now cleaves, dealing 85% Cold damage and Chilling enemies for 20% per attack.

invigorating-strike-healing.d: Heal for 2% of your Maximum Life once every 1.0 seconds for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike.

invigorating-strike-vulnerable.d: Hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

invigorating-strike-cast-speed.d: Increases Invigorating Strike Cast Speed by 5% when hitting an enemy for the first time, up to 20%, for 4 seconds.

invigorating-strike-energy.d: Gain 2 additional Energy once every 1.0 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike. If a Close enemy is Crowd Controlled, the additional Energy gain is increased to 4.

barrage-multishot.d: Barrage deals 170% damage and fires 2 additional arrows and all of its arrows now travel faster and pierce through 2 additional enemies.

barrage-broadside.d: Barrage no longer pierces and fires 2 less arrows. Its arrows each drop 1 Stun Grenade that deals 25% damage.

barrage-succession.d: Barrage fires arrows into the air, dealing 20% damage upon landing. Each arrow causes the enemy it hits to take 15%[x] increased damage from Barrage for the next 4 seconds, up to 75%[x]. Barrage now also creates an Arrow Storm, dealing 20% damage.

barrage-energy-cost-reduction.d: Barrage's Energy Cost is reduced to 24.

barrage-vulnerable-or-weakened.d: Barrage deals 20%[x] increased damage against Vulnerable or Weakened enemies.

barrage-overpower.d: Casting Barrage consumes 1 stacks of Overpower to fire 2 additional arrows and all arrows to deal 20%[x] increased damage.

shadow-step-safe-arrival.d: Shadow Step Dazes its primary target for 3 seconds and leaves 4 Stun Grenades at its feet that each deal 10% damage.

shadow-step-sight-unseen.d: Shadow Step has an additional Charge and refunds a Charge when it kills an enemy. Casting Shadow Step increases its damage by 15%[x] for 5 seconds, up to 75%[x].

shadow-step-artifice.d:
Shadow Step no longer requires a target, and it leaves a decoy at your starting location that Taunts Nearby enemies and explodes after 2 seconds, dealing 72% Shadow damage.

Shadow Step's Cooldown is increased to 12 seconds.

shadow-step-vulnerable.d: Damaging an enemy with Shadow Step applies Vulnerable to them for 4 seconds.

shadow-step-cooldown.d: Casting Shadow Step reduces its Cooldown by 3 seconds.

shadow-step-unstoppable.d: Casting Shadow Step grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

shadow-step-cleave.d: Shadow Step's stab now cleaves, dealing 10% of the original damage to the cleaved targets.

puncture-propulsion.d: Puncture now deals 56% damage and every 3rd Puncture will also ricochet up to 3 times. Hits against Slowed enemies will always ricochet.

puncture-three-of-a-kind.d:
Puncture becomes a Cutthroat Skill.

Puncture now throws 3 blades in a spread, each dealing 60% of its Base damage. Hitting an enemy with all 3 blades at once makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

puncture-blight-burst.d: Puncture now also applies 25% of its Base damage as Poisoning damage over 6 seconds and also Poisons up to 2 enemies near your target. Enemies Poisoned this way are always pierced by Puncture and your Critical Strike Chance against them is increased by 10%[+].

puncture-energy.d: Gain 3 Energy when Puncture damages an enemy and an additional 2 Energy if the enemy is Crowd Controlled.

puncture-crowd-control.d: Puncture Slows enemies by 20% for 4 seconds. Critical Strikes will Immobilize enemies for 2 seconds.

puncture-overpower.d: Every 3rd Puncture grants 1 stack of Overpower.

puncture-pierce.d: Puncture pierces through 1 enemy and has its range increased by 50%.

dark-shroud-best-served-cold.d: When a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed, it explodes in a frigid nova that deals 60% Cold damage to surrounding enemies and Chills them for 30%.

dark-shroud-overflow.d: Dark Shroud no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you 15%[x] increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.

dark-shroud-shadow-dancer.d: Casting Dark Shroud increases your Dodge Chance by 50% for 2 seconds. While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 10.0% Dodge Chance.

dark-shroud-healing.d: You Heal for 10% of your Maximum Life when a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed.

dark-shroud-consume-chance.d: Dark Shroud shadows have a 15% chance to not be consumed.

dark-shroud-critical-strike.d: While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

dark-shroud-movement-speed.d: Each active Dark Shroud shadow grants you 5%[x] Movement Speed.

cold-imbuement-frozen-heart.d: Cold Imbued Skills cause enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds. Cold Imbuement's Duration is increased by 50%[x].

cold-imbuement-buffered-battery.d: **Lucky Hit:** Cold Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to encase you in a Barrier for 3.0% of your Maximum Life, up to 30%, for 6 seconds. This Barrier reduces your Energy costs by 20%.

cold-imbuement-crystal-distillation.d: When Cold Imbuement is Cast it now also creates a frigid emanation around you for 6 seconds that deals 75% Cold damage and Chills any enemies within for 15% every 0.5 seconds.

cold-imbuement-overpower.d: When you Freeze an enemy while Cold Imbued, gain 1 stack of Overpower.

cold-imbuement-resolve.d: When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Resolve.

cold-imbuement-cooldown.d: When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, Cold Imbuement's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

cold-imbuement-energy.d: Cold Imbued Skills grant 4 Energy when hitting an enemy for the first time.

poison-trap-infiltrator.d: Poison Trap's Cooldown is reduced by 3.0 seconds. Poison Trap has no arm time, no longer breaks Stealth, and triggers no Cooldown while you are in Stealth. All Poison Traps activate when you exit Stealth and begin Poison Trap's Cooldown.

poison-trap-frostbite-trap.d: Poison Trap no longer deals Poisoning damage and instead deals 945% Frostbite damage and Chills enemies for 20% per second.

poison-trap-contamination.d: Poison Trap bursts for an additional 162% damage when it triggers. Enemies hit by this burst take 40%[x] increased damage from Poison Trap.

poison-trap-resolve.d: Casting Poison Trap grants 2 stacks of Resolve.

poison-trap-knock-down.d: Poison Trap Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds when it activates.

poison-trap-vulnerable.d: Poison Trap makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds when it activates.

poison-imbuement-sapper.d:
**Lucky Hit:** Poison Imbued Skills have up to a 100% chance to Fortify you 2.0% of your Maximum Life.

While imbued, your Fortify heals you 50% faster.

poison-imbuement-toxic-touch.d: Poison Imbuement gains 40%[x] increased Potency. Each successive time an enemy is Poisoned by Poison Imbuement, the Potency of Poison Imbuement against the enemy is increased by 5%[x], up to 50%[x].

poison-imbuement-corrosive-ring.d:
**Passive:** Poison Imbuement corrodes enemies around you, dealing 25% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

While imbued, the size of the corrosion is increased by 100%[+]. Each enemy affected by Poison Imbuement increases your Energy Regeneration by 10%[x], up to 100%[x].

poison-imbuement-energy.d: Casting Poison Imbuement generates 30 Energy, increased by 2 for each Nearby Poisoned enemy.

poison-imbuement-duration.d: Poison Imbuement's duration is increased by 2 seconds. Casting Poison Imbuement consumes up to 2 stacks of Ferocity to further increase its duration by 2 per Ferocity spent.

poison-imbuement-cooldown.d: **Lucky Hit:** Poison Imbued Skills have up to a 30% chance to reduce the Cooldown of Poison Imbuement by 2 seconds.

poison-imbuement-critical-strike.d: Critical Strikes with Poison Imbued Skills increase its Poisoning damage by 25%[x].

twisting-blades-bladedancer.d: Twisting Blades now cleaves and spirals outward around you for a short time after they return, dealing 39% damage per hit.

twisting-blades-sleight-of-hand.d: Enemies impaled by Twisting Blades are Dazed. When your Twisting Blades return, your active Cooldowns are reduced by 0.10 seconds per enemy they passed through, up to 2 seconds. Twisting Blades damage is increased by 75%[x].

twisting-blades-twisted-twin.d: Impaling an enemy with Twisting Blades also summons 1 Shade to strike a nearby target, dealing 32% damage on impale and 73% damage on returning.

twisting-blades-resolve.d: When you impale an enemy with Twisting Blades, gain 1 stack of Resolve.

twisting-blades-crowd-controlled-or-weak.n: Twisting Blades: Crowd Controlled or Weakened
twisting-blades-crowd-controlled-or-weak.d: Twisting Blades deals 20%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled or Weakened enemies.

twisting-blades-energy-cost-reduction.d: Twisted Blades' Energy Cost is reduced to 24.

twisting-blades-damage-increase-and-exec.n: Twisting Blades: Damage Increase and Execute
twisting-blades-damage-increase-and-exec.d: Twisting Blades' initial impale Executes enemies. Twisting Blades' return damage is also increased by 20%[x].

dash-detonation.d: Dash is also a Grenade Skill. At the end of Dash, explode and Knock Down surrounding enemies for 2 seconds, dealing 230% damage to them.

dash-primer.d: At the end of Dash, you enter Stealth for 4 seconds and gain 1 stack of Ferocity, increased by 1 per 5 Skill Ranks.

dash-echo.d: A Shade Dashes after you, dealing 131% damage. Dash's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second per enemy you hit, up to 5 seconds.

dash-critical-strike-chance.d: Damaging enemies with Dash increases their chance to be Critically Struck by 5%[+] for 8 seconds.

dash-weaken.d: Enemies you Dash through become Weakened for 4 seconds.

dash-charges-and-cooldown-reduction.d: Dash has 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

dash-resolve.d: At the end of Dash, gain 2 stack of Resolve.

shadow-imbuement-dark-dance.d: Evading through an enemy infected by Shadow Imbuement grants Stealth for 4 seconds and explodes the infection for 50%[x] increased damage.

shadow-imbuement-endemic.d:
**Passive:** Shadow Imbuement's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time you kill an enemy.

Any enemies you infect with Shadow Imbuement take 40% damage every second until the infection ceases.

shadow-imbuement-shadow-play.d: **Lucky Hit:** Shadow Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to create a Shade that explodes after 1 second, dealing 120% damage. This can only happen once every 0.50 seconds, affected by Attack Speed.

shadow-imbuement-vulnerable.d: Shadow Imbued Skills and Shadow Imbuement makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

shadow-imbuement-duration.d: When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, Shadow Imbuement's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.

shadow-imbuement-ferocity.d: When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Ferocity.

shadow-imbuement-overpower.d: Casting Shadow Imbuement grants 2 stacks of Overpower.

penetrating-shot-shadow-shot.d: Penetrating Shot now summons 2 Shades that also fire at your target, each dealing 60% damage.

penetrating-shot-ballista.d: Penetrating Shot takes 100% longer to fire, but shoots a larger, more powerful arrow dealing 525% damage.

penetrating-shot-trick-shot.d: Whenever Penetrating Shot damages an enemy, 2 additional arrows split off to either side. These side arrows deal 50%[x] of Penetrating Shot's Base damage and do not split.

penetrating-shot-damage-increase.d: Penetrating Shot's arrows deal 25%[x] increased damage. This bonus is reduced by 5%[x] per enemy they pierce.

penetrating-shot-slow.d: Penetrating Shot Slows enemies hit by 40% for 4 seconds.

penetrating-shot-vulnerable.d: Penetrating Shot deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

penetrating-shot-ferocity.d: Penetrating Shot deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

forceful-arrow-cloudburst.d: Forceful Arrow's Propel no longer Knocks Back Close enemies and instead creates an Arrow Storm every 3 arrows, dealing 113% damage and Slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2 seconds.

forceful-arrow-pin.d: Forceful Arrow now Immobilizes Knocked Back enemies for 1 seconds and deals 88% damage. Forceful Arrow's Knock Back range is increased by 50%.

forceful-arrow-ender.d: Forceful Arrow pierces through the first enemy hit, deals 83% damage, and has a 30% chance to Execute enemies.

forceful-arrow-vulnerable.d: Forceful Arrow causes enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

forceful-arrow-energy.d: Gain 3 Energy when Forceful Arrow damages an enemy and an additional 4 Energy after attempting to Propel an enemy.

forceful-arrow-ferocity.d: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stacks of Ferocity after attempting to Propel an enemy.

forceful-arrow-overpower.d: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stack of Overpower after attempting to Propel an enemy.

shadow-clone-awakening.d:
**Passive:** After spending 100 Energy, your next Core Skill Cast becomes a Shade Skill and spawns a Shade that deals 40% of its damage.

Shadow Clone is now also a Shade Skill and its duration is reduced by 50%[x].

shadow-clone-sentry.d:
Shadow Clone becomes a Marksman Skill and now summons a stationary shadow that fires 3 piercing arrows every 1.0 seconds. Each arrow deals 20% damage.

Shadow Clone gains 2 additional Charges, and its Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds. You may have up to 3 Shadow Clones active at a time.

shadow-clone-relentless.d: Minimum Ferocity is increased by 4 as long as Shadow Clone is present. Shadow Clone's duration is increased by 5 seconds and deals 25%[x] increased damage.

shadow-clone-cooldown.d: Shadow Clone's Cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

shadow-clone-resolve.d: Casting Shadow Clone grants 4 stacks of Resolve. While any Shadow Clone is active, you gain 1 Resolve per 1 second.

shadow-clone-unstoppable.d: Casting Shadow Clone grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

shadow-clone-weaken-vulnerable.d: Casting Shadow Clone makes all Nearby enemies Weakened and Vulnerable for 6 seconds.

death-trap-death-pit.d:
Death Trap Pulls In enemies and makes them Vulnerable and Knocked Down for 4 seconds.

Death Trap gains 1 additional charge and has its Cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.

death-trap-explosive-trigger.d:
Death Trap is also a Grenade Skill.

Death Trap also releases 16 Stun Grenades that each explode for 20% damage.

death-trap-sudden-death.d:
Death Trap's arm time is reduced by 50%, and it deals a total of 280% damage in the area.

Casting Death Trap consumes 4 stack of Overpower to reduce arm time by 100% and increase its damage by 50%[x].

death-trap-cooldown.d: Killing an enemy or dealing damage to an Elite for the first time with Death Trap reduces its Cooldown by 1 second.

death-trap-dodge.d: Casting Death Trap grants you 50% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds.

death-trap-resolve.d: Death Trap's damage is increased by 20%[x] while you have Resolve.

death-trap-weaken.d: Death Trap makes enemies Weakened for 6 seconds.

smoke-grenade-silhouette.d: Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes enemies and instead creates a cloud of shadows at your feet. While within the cloud, you gain 5.0 Critical Strike Chance and Stealth once every 1 second.

smoke-grenade-poison-grenade.d: Smoke Grenade now deals Poison damage and applies another 90% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

smoke-grenade-shade-grenade.d:
Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes and deals 90% Shadow damage. When your Smoke Grenade detonates, it also creates a Shade that leaves behind 1 grenade, dealing 68% damage.

Smoke Grenade is now also a Core Skill that no longer has a Cooldown and costs 40 Energy.

smoke-grenade-charge-or-energy-cost-redu.n: Smoke Grenade: Charge or Energy Cost Reduction
smoke-grenade-charge-or-energy-cost-redu.d: Smoke Grenade gains 1 Charge or costs 10 less Energy.

smoke-grenade-vulnerable.d: Enemies hit by Smoke Grenade become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

smoke-grenade-size.d: Smoke Grenade's size is increased by 25%.

smoke-grenade-increased-duration-and-dam.n: Smoke Grenade: Increased Duration and Damage
smoke-grenade-increased-duration-and-dam.d: Smoke Grenade gains 30%[+] increased Duration and deals 25%[x] increased damage.

rain-of-arrows-flash-flood.d: Rain of Arrows also unleashes 5 Arrow Storms that target Nearby enemies, each dealing 90% damage.

rain-of-arrows-crashing-waves.d: Rain of Arrows now comes in from the sides in shorter waves and no longer Immobilizes, but instead deals 630% damage, Knocks Back enemies towards the center, and makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

rain-of-arrows-monsoon.d:
Rain of Arrows no longer Immobilizes, and instead, its first wave Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.

Casting Rain of Arrows consumes 4 stacks of Overpower to send out 2 additional waves, each dealing 180% damage.

rain-of-arrows-cooldown.d: Rain of Arrows' Cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

rain-of-arrows-double-damage.d: Rain of Arrows deals 20%[x] increased damage and has a 25% chance to deal double damage.

rain-of-arrows-ferocity.d: Rain of Arrows' damage is increased by 10%[x] for every stack of Ferocity you have when Casting Rain of Arrows.

rain-of-arrows-cast-speed-and-lucky-hit.n: Rain of Arrows: Cast Speed and Lucky Hit
rain-of-arrows-cast-speed-and-lucky-hit.d: Rain of Arrows' Cast Speed is increased by 50%[+] and Lucky Hit Chance is increased by 50%[x].

concealment-concealing-fate.d: When you break Concealment, all Nearby enemies are covered in a shadowy mist for 4 seconds, causing them to become Vulnerable and explode for 150% Shadow damage when it expires.

concealment-recuperate.d: Entering Concealment Fortifies you for 20.0% of your Maximum Life over 5 seconds. Breaking Concealment Knocks Down Close enemies for 2 seconds.

concealment-calculation.d: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Overpower. After breaking Concealment, you gain 10.0%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for the next 6 seconds.

concealment-ferocity.d: Gain 2 stacks of Ferocity after breaking Concealment when Cast.

concealment-unstoppable.d: Unstoppable persists for 4 seconds after breaking Concealment when Cast.

concealment-resolve.d: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Resolve.

dance-of-knives-fan-of-knives.n: Dance of Knives: Fan of Knives
dance-of-knives-fan-of-knives.d: Dance of Knives now throws a fan of 5 knives that each deal 36% damage.

dance-of-knives-star-shards.d:
Knives have a 50% chance to shatter into 6 shards of metal on hit, dealing 26% damage.

Dance of Knives becomes a Marksman Skill.

dance-of-knives-grenade-jumper.d:
Dance of Knives now drops grenades instead of knives, each dealing 104%.

Dance of Knives is also a Grenade Skill.

dance-of-knives-pierce-and-size.n: Dance of Knives: Pierce and Size
dance-of-knives-pierce-and-size.d: Dance of Knives' knives has a 33% chance to pierce and grenades' explosion area is increased by 25%[+].

dance-of-knives-lucky-hit.d: Dance of Knives gains 20%[x] increased Lucky Hit Chance.

dance-of-knives-slow-and-movement-speed.n: Dance of Knives: Slow and Movement Speed
dance-of-knives-slow-and-movement-speed.d: Dance of Knives Slows enemies hit by 25% for 4 seconds and grants 12%[x] Movement Speed while Channeling.

dance-of-knives-energy-cost-reduction.n: Dance of Knives: Energy Cost Reduction
dance-of-knives-energy-cost-reduction.d: Dance of Knives' Energy Cost is reduced to 20.

flame-shield.d: Engulf yourself in flames for 1.0 seconds, becoming Immune and dealing 80% Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies.

frost-nova.d: Unleash a torrent of frost, Freezing enemies around you for 2 seconds.

ice-armor.d: A Barrier of ice forms around you for 4 seconds, absorbing [36-38]% of your Maximum Life in damage.

charged-bolts.d: Release 3 bolts of piercing lightning that course along the ground, dealing 60% damage each.

hydra.d:
Summon a 3-headed Hydra for 10.0 seconds. Each head spits fire at enemies, dealing 35% damage.

You may have up to 1 Hydras active at a time.

ice-blades.d:
**Cooldown:** 16
**Lucky Hit Chance:** 15.0%
Conjure blades of ice for 6.0 seconds that rapidly slash enemies, dealing 77% damage and making them Vulnerable.

You may have up to 3 Ice Blades active at a time.

meteor.d: Call down a meteor that crashes into enemies, dealing 240% damage and an additional 60% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

blizzard.d: Call forth a frigid blizzard that deals 1406% Frostbite damage and continually Chills enemies for 100% over 4 seconds.

frozen-orb.d: Unleash an whirling orb that deals 48% Frostbite damage over 3 seconds and Chills for 25%. After 1 second Frozen Orb will explode, dealing 167% damage.

lightning-spear.d:
Summon a spear of lightning that seeks out enemies for 6.0 seconds, dealing 120% damage per hit.

You may have up to 12 Lightning Spears active at a time.

teleport.d: Transform into lightning and surge to the target location, dealing 35% damage around you upon arrival.

ball-lightning.d: Discharge a ball of lightning that slowly moves forward and continuously zaps enemies, dealing 120% damage per second.

inferno.d: Summon a fiery serpent that deals 21% damage and Burns enemies for 85% damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

unstable-currents.d:
Lightning surges within you for 10.0 seconds. Whenever you Cast, trigger a random Skill:
- Ball Lightning
- Chain Lightning
- Charged Bolts
- Lightning Spear

deep-freeze.d:
Encase yourself in ice and become Immune for 4 seconds, Chilling surrounding enemies for 13% and continuously dealing 53% damage to them. When Deep Freeze ends, you explode for an additional 180% damage.

Casting Deep Freeze again ends the effect early.

incinerate.d:
Channel a beam of fire, dealing 14% damage and an additional 70% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

Incinerate's damage increases by 50%[x] every second you channel it, up to 100%[x].

spark.d: Launch a bolt of lightning that shocks an enemy 3 times, dealing 25% damage with each shock.

fire-bolt.d: Hurl a flaming bolt, dealing 18% damage and an additional 90% Burning damage over 6 seconds.

arc-lash.d: Unleash arcing lightning, dealing 80% damage to enemies in front of you.

fireball.d: Hurl an exploding ball of fire, dealing 170% damage to enemies.

chain-lightning.d:
