Unleash a bolt of lightning that chains up to 5 times, dealing 43% damage.

If Chain Lightning fails to chain, 50%[x] of the remaining chains damage is dealt as additional damage to the final target.

ice-shards.d:
Launch 5 icy shards, dealing 33% damage each and piercing 1 time.

Ice Shards deals 50%[x] increased damage to Frozen enemies.

frost-bolt.d: Throw a bolt of frost at an enemy, dealing 90% damage and Chilling for 35%.

firewall.d: Create a wall of fire, dealing 300% Burning damage over 3.5 seconds. Enemies continue Burning for 1.8 seconds after leaving the wall.

familiar.d:
Summon a Fire Familiar for [12.8-14.4] seconds. It seeks enemies and periodically explodes, dealing [112-126]% damage.

You may have up to 6 Familiars active at a time.

arc-lash-full-lash.d: Arc Lash now casts from both sides in a larger arc, hitting enemies caught in the middle twice.

arc-lash-inescapable-reach.d:
Arc Lash launches a swift projectile that unleashes arcing lightning at the first enemy hit, dealing up to 150%[x] increased damage based on how far the projectile travels.

Hitting an enemy with Arc Lash's projectile increases your Movement Speed by 4%[+] for 5 seconds, stacking up to 20%[+].

arc-lash-icy-thrash.d:
Arc Lash becomes a Frost Skill, deals Cold damage, and Chills for 25%.

Arc Lash has a larger range and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

arc-lash-ferocity.d: Arc Lash grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

arc-lash-damage-bonus.d: Arc Lash deals 50%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

arc-lash-resource-generation.d: Arc Lash generates 5 Mana when it hits the first enemy.

arc-lash-stun.d: Every 8 seconds your next Arc Lash will Stun all enemies hit for 2 seconds.

fire-bolt-healing.d: Fire Bolt heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life when it hits the first enemy.

fire-bolt-overpower.d: Fire Bolt grants 1 stack of Overpower.

fire-bolt-twin-flame.d: Fire Bolt launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing 18% Fire damage.

fire-bolt-resource-generation.d: Fire Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the enemy is already Burning.

fire-bolt-damage-bonus.d: Fire Bolt deals 50%[x] increased Burning damage.

fire-bolt-shiver.d:
Fire Bolt becomes a Frost Skill, dealing 27% Cold damage and 180% Frostbite damage over 6 seconds.

Fire Bolt pierces 1 time and makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

fire-bolt-firefly.d: Fire Bolt shoots out a firefly that attaches itself to an enemy and explodes 3 times after a delay, dealing 25% damage with each explosion.

frost-bolt-relentless-bolt.d: Frost Bolt launches an additional projectile after the first. Each projectile deals 72% damage.

frost-bolt-vulnerable.d: Frost Bolt makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

frost-bolt-shatter.d: Frost Bolt shatters when it hits a Frozen enemy, exploding for 270% damage and Chilling for 40%.

frost-bolt-static-shock.d:
Frost Bolt becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Frost Bolt arcs 1 to 3 times to additional enemies, dealing 36% damage with each arc and Weakening them for 4 seconds.

frost-bolt-resource-generation.d: Frost Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the target is already Frozen.

frost-bolt-barrier.d: Frost Bolt grants a Barrier for 2% of your Maximum Life up to 6% for 6 seconds when it hits the first enemy.

spark-overcharged.d: Spark shocks 4 additional times. Each time a shock does not Critically Strike it gains 10%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

spark-firework.d:
Spark becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals Fire damage.

Spark shocks now explode, dealing 45% damage that gain 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

spark-electric-blast.d: Spark combines all shocks into one blast in an area, dealing 50%[x] increased damage and gaining 25% increased Size per shock.

spark-crackling-energy.d: Spark forms a Crackling Energy the first time it damages a target.

incinerate-flamethrower.d: Incinerate gains 2 additional beams and deals its Burning damage 50% faster, but its range is reduced.

incinerate-disintegration.d:
Incinerate becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Incinerate's beam no longer penetrates enemies and it now deals 140% damage to the first enemy hit and an additional 140% damage distributed among up to 5 enemies around them.

incinerate-overpower.d: Incinerate gains a 20% chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of Overpower.

incinerate-focused-flame.d:
Incinerate maximum damage bonus while channeling is increased to 200%[x].

Incinerate's Size is increased by 200% when you reach the maximum damage bonus.

incinerate-healing.d: Incinerate heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life per enemy hit.

incinerate-healthy-damage-bonus.d: Incinerate deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

fireball-instantaneous-destruction.d: Fireball travels 200% faster and deals 75%[x] increased damage.

fireball-illumination.d: Fireball now bounces as it travels and explodes each time it hits the ground, dealing 75% of normal damage.

fireball-frostball.d:
Fireball becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

When Fireball hits an enemy it creates 3 Ice Spikes around them, dealing 85% damage each.

fireball-damage-bonus.d: Fireball deals 40%[x] increased damage, but its Mana cost is increased by 15.

fireball-damage-over-time.d: Fireball's direct damage deals an additional 30% damage over 4 seconds.

fireball-critical-strike-damage.d: Fireball deals 30%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

frozen-orb-explosion-damage-bonus.d: Frozen Orb deals 30%[x] increased explosion damage.

frozen-orb-duration-bonus.d: Frozen Orb lasts 1 additional second before exploding.

frozen-orb-barrier.d: Frozen Orb grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds for each enemy hit by its explosion, up to 50%.

frozen-orb-seeking-orb.d: When Frozen Orb first explodes it remains stationary for 0.5 seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing 134% damage.

frozen-orb-shattered-path.d:
Ice Spikes spawn around Frozen Orb, dealing 56% damage.

Frozen Orb makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

frozen-orb-great-orbs-of-fire.n: Frozen Orb: Great Orbs of Fire
frozen-orb-great-orbs-of-fire.d:
Frozen Orb becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 62% Burning damage over 2 seconds and explodes for 217% Fire damage

Frozen Orb will consume 1 stacks of Overpower to explode 3 times along its path.

frozen-orb-damage-over-time-bonus.n: Frozen Orb: Damage Over Time Bonus
frozen-orb-damage-over-time-bonus.d: Frozen Orb deals 100%[x] increased Frostbite damage.

charged-bolts-damage-bonus.d:
Charged Bolts deals 15%[x] increased damage to Close enemies.

Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

charged-bolts-weaken.d:
Charged Bolts Weakens enemies for 6 seconds.

Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

charged-bolts-movement-speed.d:
Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 4%[x] bolt speed and you gain 4 Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 20%[x].

Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

charged-bolts-surging-charge.d: Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt, plus 1 additional bolt per stack of Ferocity.

charged-bolts-cast-speed.d:
Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 5%[+] Cast Speed, up to 15%[+]. Moving removes this effect.

Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

charged-bolts-burn-through.d:
Charged Bolts becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs 30 Mana.

Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases 2 to 3 explosions on impact, dealing an additional 180% damage.

charged-bolts-overload.d:
Casting Charged Bolts now also discharges Crackling Energy in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it.

Crackling Energy will no longer automatically pulse its last 3 charges.

chain-lightning-chain-of-cold.d:
Chain Lightning becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Chain Lightning Chills by 25% and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

chain-lightning-chain-whipping.d: Chain Lightning gains 20%[+] Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

chain-lightning-power-flux.d: Chain Lightning alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains 45%[x] increased damage, up to 180%[x], and does not use a chain.

chain-lightning-critical-strike-chance.d:
Chain Lightning forms a Crackling Energy whenever it Critically Strikes.

Chain Lightning gains 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

chain-lightning-ramping-damage.d: Every Second, Chain Lightning gains 5%[x] damage, up to 25%[x]. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than Chain Lightning.

chain-lightning-damage-bonus.d: Chain Lightning deals 100%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

ice-shards-thunderbolt.d:
Ice Shards becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Ice Shards launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into 5 smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing 33% damage each.

ice-shards-glacial-spike.d: Ice Shards combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing 10%[x] increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and Chills for 50%.

ice-shards-piercing-cold.d:
Ice Shards deals 50%[x] increased damage and will pierce 1 additional time.

Ice Shards will additionally pierce up to 3 Vulnerable enemies.

ice-shards-pierce-damage-bonus.d: Ice Shards deals 20%[x] increased damage after piercing once.

ice-shards-hit-damage-bonus.d: Ice Shards deals 10%[x] increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.

ice-shards-barrier.d: Ice Shards launches 1 additional shard while you have a Barrier.

ice-shards-cost-reduction.d: Ice Shards' Mana cost is reduced by 3.

flame-shield-duration-bonus.d: Flame Shield's duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.

flame-shield-scorch.d: Flame Shield instantly scorches close enemies, dealing 14% damage and Immobilizing them for 3 seconds.

flame-shield-cooldown-reduction.d: Flame Shield's Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

flame-shield-healing.d: While Flame Shield is active, you heal for 12% of your Maximum Life per second.

flame-shield-overpower.d: Flame Shield grants 1 stack of Overpower.

flame-shield-flash.d:
Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast.

Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating 4 Crackling Energy per second and gaining 35%[x] Movement Speed and 15.0% Dodge.

flame-shield-firebird.d: Flame Shield rains down 4 Meteorites per second that deal 9% damage.

teleport-wormhole.d: Teleport Stuns enemies hit for 0.50 seconds, and there is a 2 second window where you can cast Teleport again.

teleport-blaze.d:
Teleport becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 60% Fire damage.

Teleport now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume 1 stacks of Overpower to refund its Cooldown.

teleport-ferocity.d: Teleport grants 2 stack of Ferocity if it hits an enemy.

teleport-movement-speed.d: Teleport increases your Movement Speed by 10%[+] for 4 seconds.

teleport-electrobolt.d: Teleport pulls in all Close Crackling Energy and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by 0.30 seconds per Crackling Energy gained this way.

teleport-crackling-energy.d: Teleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.

ice-armor-resource-regeneration.d: Ice Armor grants [6-6.25] Mana Regeneration while active.

ice-armor-blast-chill.d: Ice Armor also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by [12-12.5]%[x].

ice-armor-razor-ice.d: Ice Armor forms 2 Ice Spikes per second under Close enemies that deal [30-31]% damage.

ice-armor-permafrost.d: Ice Armor grants Unstoppable for 1 second and increases your Armor by [60-63]% while active.

ice-armor-cooldown-reduction.d: Ice Armor's Cooldown is reduced to 16 seconds.

ice-armor-frozen-and-chill.d: Close enemies that attack you while Ice Armor is active will be Frozen or Chilled for [12-13]%.

ice-armor-duration-bonus-and-barrier.n: Ice Armor: Duration Bonus and Barrier
ice-armor-duration-bonus-and-barrier.d: Ice Armor's duration is increased to 5 seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by 20%[x].

frost-nova-freezing-mist.d: Instead of Freezing, Frost Nova forms an aura of frigid mist around you that deals 175% Frostbite damage over 4 seconds.

frost-nova-vulnerable.d: Frost Nova makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

frost-nova-size-bonus.d: Frost Nova's Size is increased by 50%.

frost-nova-cold-front.d: Frost Nova is now cast at a target location, and each enemy Frozen by it reduces the cooldowns of your Frost Skills by 0.5 seconds.

frost-nova-shatter.d: Enemies that die while Frozen by Frost Nova have a 100% chance to unleash an additional Frost Nova.

frost-nova-resource-generation.d: Each enemy Frozen by Frost Nova generates 5 Mana.

frost-nova-charge.d: Frost Nova gains 1 additional Charge, but its Cooldown is increased by 6 seconds.

familiar-size-bonus.d: Familiar's explosion radius is increased by 50%.

familiar-duration-bonus.d: Familiar's duration is increased by 4 seconds.

familiar-healing-flames.d: Casting Familiar grants 1 stack of Overpower and restores [1.6-1.8]% of your Maximum Life per second while active.

familiar-bonus-effect.d:
Gain a bonus based on the Familiar type when the Familiar explodes:

- Fire Familiar  Gain [8-9]%[+] Healing Received for 5 seconds.
- Cold Familiar  Gain a Barrier for [8-9]% of your Maximum Life for [8-9] seconds, up to [48-54]%.
- Lightning Familiar  Reduce a random active Cooldown by [0.8-0.9] seconds.

familiar-freezing-familiar.d:
Familiar becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Familiar Chills for [24-27]% and Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

familiar-fast-as-lightning.d:
Familiar becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Familiar increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 and grants [3.20-3.60]% Cooldown Reduction while active.

familiar-prismatic-familiar.d:
Familiar becomes a Pyromancy, Shock, and Frost Skill that summons a stationary Prismatic Familiar.

Casting Skills will cause Prismatic Familiar to apply [168-189]% Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.

hydra-cooldown-reduction.d: Hydra reduces the Cooldown of a random Skill by 0.3 seconds whenever it attacks.

hydra-cast-speed.d: Hydra gains 50% Cast Speed, but its duration is reduced to 8 seconds.

hydra-healing.d: Hydra heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life each time it deals damage.

hydra-overpower.d: Hydra gains 1 head for every 3 Overpower you have on Cast.

hydra-bathed-in-flame.d:
Hydra is bathed in flame, dealing 28% Burning damage per second to surrounding enemies. 

Hydra's attacks now instead deal 70% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

hydra-behemoth.d:
Hydra Summons a massive 1-headed Hydra that spits explosive fire and deals 20% increased damage for each extra head it would have had.

Hydra no longer costs Mana, but has a 15 second Cooldown. You can now have up to 10 total Hydras at one time.

hydra-frigid-hydra.d:
Hydra becomes a Frost Skill that deals 61% Cold damage.

Hydra's attacks pierce enemies and Chill for 15%.

ice-blades-cooldown-reduction.d: Ice Blades' Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time it attacks an enemy.

ice-blades-blazing-blades.d:
Ice Blades becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 115% Fire damage.

Ice Blades no longer has a Cooldown, but costs 20 Mana. Ice Blades gain 30% Cast Speed.

ice-blades-frozen-tomb.d:
Ice Blades is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with 3 Ice Blades.

Ice Blades Chill enemies for 10%, but their Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

ice-blades-ice-crack.d: Every 3rd slash from Ice Blades is an Ice Crack, dealing 230% damage in a large cone.

ice-blades-duration-bonus.d: Ice Blades' duration is increased by 5 seconds.

ice-blades-cast-speed.d: Ice Blades gains 50%[+] Cast Speed when attacking Frozen enemies.

lightning-spear-duration-bonus.d: When a Lightning Spear Critically Strikes, its duration is increased by 0.1 seconds.

lightning-spear-reverse-polarity.d: Lightning Spear fires 2 spears that deal 96% damage Stun enemies for 1.0 seconds. Enemies can only be Stunned this way once every 5 seconds.

lightning-spear-chain-reaction.d: Lightning Spear arcs to 2 additional surrounding targets dealing 48% damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.

lightning-spear-flame-spear.d:
Lightning Spear becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals 198% Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds

Burning enemies hit by Lightning Spear explode for 120%.

lightning-spear-critical-strike.d: Lightning Spear gains 10% increased Critical Strike Chance.

lightning-spear-damage-bonus.d: Lightning Spear deals 100%[x] increased damage. This bonus is reduced by 10%[x] each time Lightning Spear deals damage to an enemy.

blizzard-exposure.d: Blizzard's duration is increased to 6 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.

blizzard-hailstorm.d: Blizzard forms Ice Spikes that explode twice if they hit a Vulnerable enemy, dealing 49% damage.

blizzard-static-field.d:
Blizzard becomes a Shock Skill, deals 2109% Sparking damage over 1.0 seconds, and costs 15 Mana.

Blizzard periodically Stuns enemies for [0.50-0.55] seconds.

blizzard-seek-and-duration-bonus.d: Blizzard now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by 50%.

blizzard-resource-generation.d: Blizzard deals 3%[x] increased damage and grants 2 Mana Regeneration for each active Blizzard, up to 10 Mana.

blizzard-barrier.d: Blizzard grants you a Barrier that absorbs 0.5% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds every second for each affected enemy.

blizzard-damage-bonus.d: Blizzard deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

meteor-resource-damage-bonus.d: Meteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing 2%[x] increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.

meteor-overpower.d: Meteor's Impact damage now grants 1 stack of Overpower per enemy hit.

meteor-shooting-star.d:
Removes the falling delay before Meteor crashes down.

Meteor now deals 408% impact damage and 102% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

meteor-immobilize.d: Meteor Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds on impact.

meteor-damage-and-size-bonus.d: Meteor deals 50%[x] increased damage and has 50%[x] increased Size, but now also has a 15 second Cooldown.

meteor-comet.d:
Meteor becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Meteor calls down an icy Comet that deals 360% damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts 66% Frostbite and 50% Chill over 3 seconds.

meteor-air-burst.d: Meteor rains down 6 Meteorites before the final impact that each deal 88% damage each, but Meteor no longer deals Burning damage.

firewall-ring-of-fire.d:
Firewall creates a ring of fire that deals 300% Fire damage over 3.5 seconds, but it now has a 12 second Cooldown.

Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage from Pyromancy Skills to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.

firewall-wildfire.d: Firewall's Size is increased by 50% and duration increased to 7.0 seconds.

firewall-healing.d:
Firewall heals you for 0.3% of your Maximum Life every second per affected enemy.

Every [X] Life healed by Firewall grants you 1 stack of Overpower.

firewall-grounding.d:
Firewall becomes a Shock Skill, deals 150% Sparking damage over 3.5 seconds, and costs 30 Mana.

**Lucky Hit:** Up to a 25% chance to deal 300% damage and form a Crackling Energy against enemies affected by Firewall.

firewall-cost-reduction.d: Every 100 Mana spent makes your next Firewall cost no Mana, stacking up to 300 total Mana.

firewall-damage-bonus.d: Firewall deals 75%[x] increased damage, but its duration is reduced by 25%[+].

ball-lightning-crackling-energy.d: Ball Lightning forms 3 Crackling Energy when it dissipates.

ball-lightning-damage-bonus.d: Ball Lightning deals 30%[x] increased damage when it hits 3 or fewer enemies.

ball-lightning-multiple-projectiles.d: Ball Lightning has a 20% chance to form a second Ball Lightning.

ball-lightning-attraction.d: Ball Lightning now deals 204% damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.

ball-lightning-orbital.d: Ball Lightning orbits you and now deals 144% damage around you per second.

ball-lightning-implosion.d:
Ball Lightning becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a 12 second Cooldown.

Ball Lightning is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing 480% damage over 2 seconds.

ball-lightning-ferocity.d: Ball Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

deep-freeze-glacier.d:
Instead of encasing yourself and becoming Immune, Deep Freeze now forms at the target location dealing 63% damage continuously and 216% explosion damage.

You remain free to act during the duration and Deep Freeze now has 3 Charges.

deep-freeze-bonechill.d:
Deep Freeze's continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals 420% and 1440% damage over 4 seconds respectively.

This Frostbite damage Chills for 100% over 4 seconds and will remove Unstoppable from enemies.

deep-freeze-frigid-ward.d:
Deep Freeze forms a Barrier that absorbs [X](30% of Maximum Life) damage every second while active, and also forms exploding Ice Spikes in the area, dealing 39% Cold damage.

This Barrier grants 10 Mana Regeneration.

deep-freeze-vulnerable-and-weakened.d: Damage makes enemies Vulnerable and Weakened for 8 seconds.

deep-freeze-cooldown-with-barrier.d: Cooldown speed is increased by 50% while you have a Barrier.

deep-freeze-reduce-cooldown.d: Reduces your Cooldowns by 1 second and generate 8 Mana every second while active.

inferno-direct-damage-bonus.d:
Inferno's Burning damage is now converted to direct Fire damage, allowing it to Critically Strike.

Inferno deals 20% increased Critical Strike Damage.

inferno-cooldown-reduction.d: Inferno's Cooldown is reduced to 12 seconds, but it now also costs 30 Mana.

inferno-meteor-shower.d: Inferno triggers Meteorites that deal 149% to enemies and Immobilize them for 1.0 second.

inferno-living-bomb.d: Inferno's Burning duration is increased to 8 seconds. Enemies killed by Inferno explode, dealing 106% damage.

inferno-lifecoil.d: Inferno now forms around you and follows you, healing you for 50% of your Maximum Life per second.

inferno-pull.d: Inferno continuously pulls enemies towards the center.

inferno-overpower.d: Inferno overfills your Overpower by 2 stacks.

unstable-currents-cooldown-reduction.d: Unstable Currents' Cooldown is reduced to 100 seconds.

unstable-currents-damage-bonus.d: Unstable Currents increases your Shock Skill damage by 20%[x].

unstable-currents-ramping-currents.d: Unstable Currents now has a 25% chance to trigger twice.

unstable-currents-cost-reduction.d: Unstable Currents reduces your Mana costs by 5.

unstable-currents-thunder-god.d: Unstable Currents now triggers equipped Shock Skills that deal 50%[x] increased damage, but the same Skill cannot be triggered more than once every 1 second.

unstable-currents-boundless.d:
While Unstable Currents is active, gain the following bonuses:
- **Lucky Hit:** Up to a 25.0% chance to form a Crackling Energy
- Increases Crackling Energy damage by 2.5%[x] and reduces Unstable Currents' Cooldown by 0.10 seconds when absorbing Crackling Energy.
- Automatically absorb Nearby Crackling Energy.

unstable-currents-ferocity.d: Unstable Currents increases your Minimum and Maximum Ferocity by 2.

withering-fist.d:
Dart at and jab an enemy several times, dealing a total of 5% damage and applying 80% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

Your 3rd attack bursts on your target, damaging surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.

vortex.d: Create a cyclone that Pulls enemies inward followed by a crushing downdraft that deals 35% damage to them.

crushing-hand.d: Smash down next to you with devastating force, creating 2 shockwaves on either side that overlap and each deal 90% damage.

scourge.d: Call forth a wave of insects that bite enemies, Fearing and Slowing them by 70% for 3 seconds while applying 100% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

payback.d:
Smash enemies in front of you, dealing 175% damage.

When attacked, you have a 5% chance to reset Payback's Cooldown.

thrash.d:
Dive at an enemy and slash into it dealing 40% damage.

Your 3rd attack unleashes a rapid series of slashes around your target, dealing a total of 100% damage.

rock-splitter.d:
Rush at a target and clobber enemies in front of you, dealing 50% damage.

Your 3rd attack strikes enemies around you, dealing 110% damage.

thunderspike.d:
Quickly jab forward with a piercing strike dealing 45% damage.

Your 3rd attack pierces further, dealing 90% damage.

rake.d: Conjure claws that rake through enemies in front of you, dealing 50% damage before exploding for an additional 75% damage.

quill-volley.d: Hurl 5 feathers that pierce through enemies, each dealing 25% damage.

toxic-skin.d:
**Passive:** Enemies that attack you are Poisoned for 72% damage over 6 seconds.

**Active:** Your toxins overflow, applying the Poisoning in a trail and making you Unhindered for 5.0 seconds.

rushing-claw.d: Slash a short distance through an enemy, striking all enemies along the way twice for a total of 160% total damage.

armored-hide.d:
**Passive:** Gain 1 Resolve every 5.0 seconds.

**Active:** Encase yourself, gaining 40%[+] Block Chance for 3 seconds.

soar.d: Fly into the air, creating a cloud which makes enemies at your target location Vulnerable for 4.0 seconds before you crash down upon them dealing 50% damage.

ravager.d:
**Passive:** Minimum Ferocity increased by 1.

**Active:** Unleash a savage roar, causing each of your attacks to trigger an additional 50% damage strike per enemy for 6 seconds.

concussive-stomp.d: Stomp in front of you, releasing a shockwave that deals 65% damage and Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.

counterattack.d:
**Passive:** Gain 10% Dodge Chance and automatically retaliate against Close enemies for 80% damage when you Dodge their attacks.

**Active:** Dodge all direct attacks for 3 seconds per cast, up to 6 seconds.

touch-of-death.d:
Strike an enemy and infect them, dealing 5% damage and applying 400% Poisoning damage over 9 seconds.

When the infection expires or the host dies, a swarm hatches and seeks enemies for 9 seconds, dealing 10% damage per hit.

You can have up to 3 swarms active at once.

the-devourer.d: The Centipede Spirit emerges, blasting enemies in a line for 200% damage and spitting at others for 95% damage. Lasts for 15 seconds.

the-seeker.d: The Eagle Spirit swoops down and deals 52% damage. After a short delay it blasts off dealing 450% damage.

the-hunter.d: Bound across the battlefield with the Jaguar Spirit, dealing 50% damage upon landing and then rapidly slashing enemies in the area for 200% total damage over 7 strikes.

the-protector.d: The Gorilla Spirit protects an area for 6 seconds, continuously smashing surrounding enemies for 140% damage and granting you Barrier for 10% of your Maximum Life every 1.5 seconds.

razor-wings.d:
Whirl out a cluster of razor sharp feathers that rebound back, dealing 120% damage each way.

You can have up to 15 active Razor Wings.

stinger.d: Strike a small area, dealing 140% damage to enemies within as well as all surrounding Poisoned enemies.

counterattack-asymmetrical-warfare.d: Counterattack's Passive now also retaliates against all Close enemies for 100% damage when you Dodge any attack.

counterattack-controlled-reflection.d: When you Dodge a Control Impairing attack with Counterattack it will reflect that Crowd Control to all Close enemies for 2 seconds.

counterattack-counterattack-of-the-swarm.d:
Counterattack is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.

**Passive:** Your Pestilent Swarms Weaken enemies.

**Active:** Send out 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 75% damage each second for 3 seconds.

counterattack-cooldown-reduction.d: Counterattack's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds per stack of Ferocity you have.

counterattack-damage-over-time-reduction.d: Counterattack's Passive reduces Damage Over Time effects on you by 20%.

counterattack-duration-increase.d: Counterattack's duration is increased by 1 seconds.

concussive-stomp-crushing-blow.d: Concussive Stomp hits in a circle around you and deals 500% increased damage to Unstoppable enemies and Bosses.

concussive-stomp-debilitate.d: Concussive Stomp grants you 15% Damage Reduction for 4 seconds. When enemies recover from a Concussive Stomp, they have 30% reduced Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

concussive-stomp-crackling-earth.d:
Concussive Stomp is also an Eagle Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has a 7 second Cooldown.

Concussive Stomp electrifies the ground, Sparking enemies for 400% Damage over 2 seconds and causing them to drop a Storm Feather.

concussive-stomp-barrier-generation.d: Concussive Stomp grants a Barrier equal to 10% of your Maximum Life per enemy hit for 3 seconds, up to 30%.

concussive-stomp-additional-charge.d: Concussive Stomp gains an additional Charge.

scourge-scourge-commander.d: Scourge now appears at your target location and deals an extra 80% damage. This amount is increased by 200% against Vulnerable enemies.

scourge-the-beast-within.d:
Scourge is also a Gorilla Skill.

Unleash the power of the Gorilla, gaining [X] Thorns for each surrounding enemy for 5 seconds and triggering a Thorns attack dealing 200% against them. Repeat this damage every 0.75 seconds for 1.5 seconds.

scourge-hive-mind.d: Scourge grants you 15% Damage Reduction and continuously affects enemies around you for 4.5 seconds.

scourge-healing.d: **Lucky Hit:** Hitting an enemy affected by Scourge has up to a 30% chance to Heal you for 5% of your Maximum Life.

scourge-vulnerable.d: Enemies affected by Scourge are Vulnerable.

scourge-weaken.d: Scourge also Weakens enemies for 6 seconds.

scourge-vigor-generation.d: Casting Scourge grants 50 Vigor over 6 seconds.

armored-hide-trampled-under-foot.d: When you Evade through enemies with Armored Hide active, you deal 300% of your Thorns to them. Activating Armored Hide deals 200% of your Thorns to Close enemies.

armored-hide-force-of-nature.d: Armored Hide restores 50 Vigor and makes you Unstoppable for the duration.

armored-hide-ferocious-meal.d:
Armored Hide is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.

**Passive:** Each time you take damage, gain a stack of Ferocity

**Active:** Perform large slashes all around you, dealing 125% damage twice. Restore 2% of your Maximum Life each time this damages an enemy. Receive 25% increased Healing for 3.0 seconds.

armored-hide-thorns.d: Armored Hide's Passive increases your Thorns by 20%.

armored-hide-blocked-damage-reduction.d: While Armored Hide is active, gain 15%[+] Blocked Damage Reduction.

armored-hide-barrier.d: Armored Hide also grants a Barrier for 20% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds.

armored-hide-duration.d: Armored Hide active duration is increased by 1 seconds.

ravager-carnage.d: Ravager deals 100%[x] increased damage, further increased to 300%[x] against Elites and Bosses.

ravager-flurry-of-claws.d:
Ravager's Passive gains: Whenever a Skill comes off Cooldown, deal 80% damage to Close enemies.

While Ravager is active, gain 25% Cooldown Rate.

ravager-strength-of-the-forest.d:
Ravager is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.

**Passive:** Whenever you gain a stack of Resolve, deal 80% damage around you.

**Active:** For 6 seconds, casting a Gorilla Skill gives you a stack of Resolve.

ravager-duration-increase.d: Ravager's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

ravager-vigor-generation.d: While Ravager is active, gain 50% increased Vigor Generation.

ravager-ferocity-maximum.d: Ravager's Passive also increases your Maximum Ferocity by 2.

soar-free-bird.d: Soar makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

soar-eye-of-the-storm.d: Soar's cloud deals 100% Sparking damage each second and remains around you for 3 seconds after landing. Soar conjures 3 Spirit Storms around its impact area that Spark enemies for 150% damage.

soar-jaguars-execution.d:
Soar is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.

Soar lunges into the air and directly back down, dealing 100% damage twice. This ability can Execute enemies.

soar-cooldown-reduction.d: Soar's Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

soar-movement-speed.d: Soar gives you 10% Movement Speed increase for 3 seconds. If Soar hits no enemies, gain 25% instead.

vortex-overcharged.d: Vortex makes enemies Vulnerable for 4.0 seconds and Sparks enemies for 200% damage over 2 seconds.

vortex-1000-year-storm.d: Vortex deals 200%[x] increased damage, affects a 50% larger area, and grants 20% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds.

vortex-insect-swarm.d:
Vortex is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.

Vortex creates a wave of insects that swarm around you, dealing 20% damage and Slowing enemies by 90% for 5 seconds. They create a Poison nova, damaging enemies for 175% damage over 5 seconds.

vortex-knock-down.d: Vortex Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds.

vortex-cooldown-reduction.d: Critical Strikes with Vortex reduce its Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

rushing-claw-evasive-swipe.d:
Rushing Claw is also an Eagle Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has 2 Charges with a 25 second Charge Cooldown.

You no longer need a target to Cast Rushing Claw.

rushing-claw-colossal-claw.d:
Rushing Claw now has 12 Maximum Charges. Casting it consumes all Charges to increase its damage by 50%[x] per Charge and it hits a larger area.

Rushing Claw's Cooldown refreshes 10% faster for each Ferocity you have.

rushing-claw-evolving-claws.d:
Rushing Claw deals 30% increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it:
- **1:** Heals 15% of your Maximum Life.
- **2:** Guaranteed to Critically Strike.
- **3:** Gain 100% Dodge Chance for 1.5 seconds. 
- **4+:** Strikes an additional time.

Using Rushing Claw's last Charge will refill 4 Charges by consuming 4 stacks of Ferocity.

rushing-claw-incarnate-duration.d: Rushing Claw extends the duration of your active Incarnate Skills by 0.5 seconds, up to 4.0 seconds.

rushing-claw-damage-bonus.d: Rushing Claw deals 60%[x] more damage if you Dodged in the last 5 seconds.

rushing-claw-damage-increase.d: Enemies hit by Rushing Claw take 20%[x] increased damage from Rushing Claw, up to 100%[x].

toxic-skin-erupting-skin.d: While Toxic Skin is active, you launch toxic globs that apply 250% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds

toxic-skin-skuttle-bug.d: Toxic Skin's Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds and its damage Weakens enemies. While its active, you gain 50% Armor.

toxic-skin-fiery-soul.d:
Toxic Skin is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.

**Passive:** Whenever you receive Healing, gain 25%[+] Critical Strike Damage until your next Critical Strike, up to 200%[+].

**Active:** Jaguar energy flows through you, automatically slashing Close enemies for 60% damage every 0.5 seconds for 5.0 seconds.

toxic-skin-duration-increase.d: Toxic Skin's duration is increased by 2 seconds

toxic-skin-healing.d: While Toxic Skin is active, Heal for 3% of your Maximum Life per second.

toxic-skin-vigor-generation.d: Toxic Skin generates 5 Vigor per second while active.

toxic-skin-thorns.d: Toxic Skin passively increases your Thorns by 20%[x].

payback-break-free.d: Becoming Control Impaired or Injured while Payback is on Cooldown makes it free to Cast and grants you Unstoppable and 40% Damage Reduction for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 8 seconds.

payback-wrath-of-the-gorilla.d:
Payback is also a Core Skill that costs 70 Vigor, has no Cooldown, and deals 325% damage.

When attacked, you have a 5% chance to gain 70 Vigor instead.

payback-insidious-retribution.d:
Payback is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.

Payback smashes enemies in front of you, Poisoning them for 330% damage over 6 seconds and increasing your Thorns by 30% for 5 seconds.

Whenever you Crowd Control an enemy, reduce Payback's Cooldown by 0.1 seconds.

payback-area-increase.d: Payback echoes forward damaging a larger area.

payback-block-chance.d: Payback grants 20%[+] Block Chance for 5 seconds.

payback-damage-increase.d: Each time an enemy attacks you, the damage they take from Payback is increased by 10%[x], up to 50%[x].

stinger-potent-sting.d: Stinger now always deals its damage to surrounding enemies, even if they are not Poisoned. If they were Poisoned, it deals 50%[x] increased damage.

stinger-unleash-the-swarm.d: Stinger spawns 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 100% damage.

stinger-nimbostratal-strike.d:
Stinger is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Stinger strikes a small area, dealing 180% damage and creating a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 200% damage. Your other Spirit Storms also deal 180% damage.

stinger-healing-and-vulnerable.d: If Stinger strikes a Vulnerable enemy it Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life. If you are Healthy it makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

stinger-damage-bonus.d: Stinger's initial impact deals 30% increased damage.

stinger-weakened-damage-bonus.d: Stinger deals 25% more damage to Weakened enemies.

crushing-hand-unrelenting-assault.d: Every 3rd Crushing Hand smashes 12 additional times dealing 36% damage each.

crushing-hand-heavy-hitter.d: Crushing Hand smashes a single time in a smaller area in front of you, dealing 360% damage and 150% of your Thorns.

crushing-hand-100-crushing-hands.d:
Crushing Hand is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.

Crushing Hand sends centipedes scuttling across the ground, Poisoning enemies for 360% damage over 6 seconds. Enemies Poisoned from Crushing Hand are Weakened.

crushing-hand-barrier.d: Crushing Hand grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds, up to 30%.

crushing-hand-block-to-damage.d: Blocking increases the damage of Crushing Hand by 5%[x] for 5 seconds, up to 25%[x].

crushing-hand-increased-cost-and-damage.n: Crushing Hand: Increased Cost and Damage
crushing-hand-increased-cost-and-damage.d: Crushing Hand costs 100% more Vigor but deals 50%[x] more damage.

quill-volley-volatile-feathers.d: Quill Volley's feathers explode at their apex, dealing 30% damage.

quill-volley-quill-command.d: Quill Volley's feathers fly 50% further and converge on your target, dealing 100%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

quill-volley-claw-volley.d:
Quill Volley is also a Jaguar skill that deals Fire damage and costs 10 less Vigor.

Quill Volley sends out 3 piercing claws that deal 44% damage twice.

quill-volley-bonus-feathers.d: Quill Volley hurls out 2 additional feathers. Consume 2 Nearby Storm Feathers to shoot out 2 more.

quill-volley-vulnerable-damage.d: Quill Volley makes enemies Vulnerable. If they are already Vulnerable, Quill Volley deals 20% more damage.

quill-volley-returning-feathers.d: Quill Volley costs 100% more Vigor and the feathers return after reaching their Max distance.

quill-volley-evade-damage.d: Quill Volley deals 20% increased damage when Cast within 5 seconds of Evading.

rake-simian-swipe.d:
Rake is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.

Rake sweeps in front of you, dealing 219% damage and gaining a stack of Resolve if you hit an enemy.

rake-grasping-claw.d:
Rake is 20% larger. Rake's initial hit pulls in enemies at its edge and hits enemies again for 75% damage.

If Rake only hits a single target, it deals 100%[x] increased damage.

rake-spirit-jaguar.d: Rake manifests a spirit Jaguar which rakes a random enemy dealing 50% damage before exploding for 65% damage.

rake-ferocity.d: Casting Rake grants a stack of Ferocity.

rake-cooldown-reduction.d: Hitting at least one enemy with Rake reduces your longest active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

rake-cost-reduction-and-damage.d: For each stack of Ferocity you have, Rake's Vigor cost is reduced by 2 and its initial hit's damage is increased by 5%.

rock-splitter-unbreakable.d: Rock Splitter's 3rd attack grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 5 seconds and generates Resolve.

rock-splitter-inner-ferocity.d:
Rock Splitter is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.

Rock Splitter's 3rd attack hits twice, dealing 100% damage each hit. If you have 4 stacks of Ferocity, hit an additional time.

rock-splitter-shattered-stone.d: Rock Splitter increases your Thorns by [X] for 5 seconds and your 3rd attack deals 100% of your Thorns to enemies.

rock-splitter-free-strike.d: Every 5 times you Block, automatically cast Rock Splitter's 3rd attack.

rock-splitter-block-and-vigor.d: Rock Splitter increases your Block Chance by 15%[+] for 5 seconds and when you Block you gain 15 Vigor.

rock-splitter-crowd-control-damage.d: Rock Splitter deals 20%[x] increased damage when hitting a Slowed or Knocked Down enemy.

thunderspike-infected-ground.d:
Thunderspike is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.

Thunderspike leaves a trail of poison that deals 60% damage over 6 seconds.

thunderspike-lightning-dancer.d: When you Evade, you attack with Thunderspike along the way for 100% of normal damage.

thunderspike-lightnings-grip.d: Thunderspike's 3rd attack strikes back again for 90% damage, Pulling in and applying Vulnerable to enemies.

thunderspike-damage-to-sparking.d: Thunderspike deals 50% increased damage to Sparking enemies.

thunderspike-movement-speed.d: Thunderspike increases your Movement Speed by 15%[x] for 5 seconds.

thunderspike-critical-strike.d: After you Critically Strike 15 times, Thunderspike's next use will be its 3rd attack and always Critically Strike.

thunderspike-vigor-generation.d: Thunderspike generates 7 additional Vigor if you have moved in the last 2 seconds.

thrash-crashing-and-thrashing.d: Thrash's 3rd attack deals 50%[x] increased damage. Thrash continues to unleash its 3rd attack if Cast again within 2.5 seconds.

thrash-wanton-rampage.d: Thrash's 1st and 2nd attacks have a 30% chance to also unleash its 3rd attack that is 40% larger and deals 20%[x] increased damage.

thrash-storm-conjurer.d:
Thrash is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Thrash's 3rd attack deals 135% damage and creates a moving Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 200% damage.

thrash-vigor-generation.d: Killing an enemy empowers your next Thrash to generate 10 additional Vigor. This stacks up to the next 10 Casts of Thrash.

thrash-ferocity.d: Thrash's 3rd attack grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.

thrash-cooldown-reduction.d: Each hit of Thrash has a 10% chance to reduce an active Cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

thrash-ramping-damage.d: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage that enemy takes from Thrash by 2%[x], stacking up to 30%[x].

withering-fist-shared-suffering.d: Withering Fist's 3rd attack spreads its Poisoning to 5 Nearby enemies and Slows them for 40% more.

withering-fist-precision-strike.d: Withering Fist's 3rd attack's burst is 30% smaller, but deals 600% increased Poisoning damage and applies Vulnerable.

withering-fist-fist-of-the-forest.n: Withering Fist: Fist of the Forest
withering-fist-fist-of-the-forest.d:
Withering Fist is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.

Withering Fist's 3rd attack releases a shockwave that deals 150% damage. It grants Barrier equal to 5% of your Maximum Health for 6 seconds per enemy hit, up to 60%.

withering-fist-vigor-generation.d: You gain 5 Vigor per second for every Nearby enemy Poisoned by Withering Fist, up to 10.

withering-fist-healing.d: Withering Fist Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life.

withering-fist-weakened.d: Enemies Poisoned by Withering Fist are Weakened.

withering-fist-poisoning-duration.d: Withering Fist's Poisoning duration is increased by 2 seconds.

touch-of-death-swarm-of-swarms.n: Touch of Death: Swarm of Swarms
touch-of-death-swarm-of-swarms.d:
Touch of Death is also a Core Skill which costs 70 Vigor and has no Cooldown.

When a swarm is replaced early, it bursts for 150% of the damage it would have done.

touch-of-death-touch-of-lightning.n: Touch of Death: Touch of Lightning
touch-of-death-touch-of-lightning.d:
Touch of Death is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Touch of Death strikes an enemy, dealing 200% damage and conjuring a Spirit Storm which Sparks enemies for 450% damage. If the enemy dies before the Spirit Storm dissipates, conjure a second moving Spirit Storm.

When you conjure a Spirit Storm, reduce Touch of Death's Cooldown by 1 second.

touch-of-death-erupting-swarm.d: Touch of Death's swarm bursts every second, applying 120% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to surrounding enemies.

touch-of-death-additional-charge.d: Touch of Death gains an additional Charge.

touch-of-death-vulnerable.d: Touch of Death makes enemies Vulnerable.

touch-of-death-healing.d: Touch of Death's infection Heals you for 1.0% of your Maximum Life per second for a total of 9% Maximum Life. You Heal any remaining when the swarm hatches.

touch-of-death-weakened-damage.d: If Touch of Death's strike hits a Weakened enemy, Touch of Death deals 20%[x] increased damage.

the-protector-canopy-shelter.d: The Protector's area persists for an additional 6 seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by 80%. While inside, you are Unstoppable.

the-protector-brutal-barrage.d: The Protector also deals 175% damage to enemies around you with each smash. Spend up to 3 stacks of Resolve to increase The Protector's damage by 100% for each stack spent.

the-protector-the-infected-forest.d:
The Protector is also a Centipede Skill.

The Centipede Spirit aids The Protector, poisoning enemies for 100% damage each second, Weakening them, and spawning Pestilent Swarms that deal 100% damage.

the-protector-barrier.d: The Protector grants an additional 10% of your Maximum Life in Barrier.

the-protector-resolve-generation.d: The Protector grants 2 Resolve when it smashes.

the-protector-thorns-damage.d: The Protector's area deals 350%[x] of your Thorns damage to enemies within every 1.5 seconds.

the-devourer-sky-and-soil.d:
The Devourer is also an Eagle Skill.

The Eagle Spirit aids The Devourer, creating a Lightning Storm that Sparks enemies for 80% damage each second and makes enemies Vulnerable. Gain 20% Movement Speed while The Devourer is active.

the-devourer-blast-of-bile.d:
The Devourer now only blasts enemies in a line once, dealing 800% damage, before leaving.

The Devourer is now also a Potency Skill and has a 18 second cooldown.

the-devourer-spew-putrefaction.d: As it emerges, The Devourer launches 10 toxic globs that apply 210% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds wherever they land. Enemies affected by toxic globs also take 50%[x] increased Poison Damage.

the-devourer-healing.d: The Devourer Heals you for 5% of your Maximum Life per second.

the-devourer-thorns.d: The Devourer grants you 50% increased Thorns for 15 seconds.

the-devourer-instant-kill.d: While The Devourer is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned, they die instantly.

the-devourer-poisoning-duration.d: While The Devourer is active, your Poisoning effects have 20% increased duration.

the-hunter-shredder.d: The Hunter strikes an additional 5 times and consumes all of your Ferocity to deal 20%[x] increased damage per Ferocity.

the-hunter-push-and-pounce.d:
The Hunter is also a Gorilla Skill.

The Gorilla Spirit knocks enemies towards The Hunter's landing spot, dealing 150% Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies on landing for 2 seconds. Each enemy you damage with The Hunter grants Resolve, which can overfill your Resolve by 4 stacks.

the-hunter-relentless-pursuit.d: The Hunter overfills your Ferocity by 2 stacks. Killing enemies while with it active has a 40% chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.

the-hunter-size-bonus.d: The Hunter strikes a 50% larger area.

the-hunter-execute.d: The Hunter's landing damage will Execute enemies.

the-hunter-healing.d: The Hunter restores 3% of your Maximum Health per strike.

the-seeker-lone-seeker.d: The Seeker now only has 1 Charge, its area is increased by 50%, and it deals 250% increased damage.

the-seeker-stormbringer.d: The Seeker's first hit Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds and leaves behind a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 240% damage

the-seeker-tag-team.d:
The Seeker is also a Jaguar Skill.

The Jaguar Spirit aids The Seeker, granting you 4 Ferocity and slashing 3 times dealing 75% Fire Damage. The Seeker gains 2 additional Charges.

the-seeker-charge-refund.d: Elites hit twice by The Seeker have a 25% chance to refund a Charge, doubled against Bosses.

the-seeker-vulnerable.d: The Seeker constantly makes all enemies in its area Vulnerable.

the-seeker-storm-feathers.d: The Seeker drops 5 Storm Feathers when it swoops down.

razor-wings-wing-storm.d: When Razor Wings hits an enemy for the first time, creates a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 150% damage. For each active Spirit Storm, Razor Wings deals 15%[x] increased damage.

razor-wings-flock-of-feathers.d: Razor Wings last 300% longer and spiral outwards.

razor-wings-brutal-blast.d:
Razor Wings is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.

Razor Wings generates 2 Resolve and fires a slow moving burst of energy that continually pulses, dealing 200% damage every 0.5 seconds.

razor-wings-movement-speed.d: For each active Razor Wings, you gain 2%[x] Movement Speed.

razor-wings-damage-increase.d: Razor Wings hits increase your Razor Wings damage by 1%[x] for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%[x]. Critical Strikes grant 3 stacks.

razor-wings-refund-charges.d: Razor Wings has a 15% chance to regain a Charge when hitting an enemy. Double this chance if you have an active Barrier.

razor-wings-charge-cooldown.d: Razor Wings' Cooldown is 40% longer but it now regains all Charges at once.

nether-step.d: Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining 4 stacks of Shadowform as well as 50%[x] increased Movement Speed which decays over 4.0 seconds.

infernal-breath.d: Summon a demonic head for 7 seconds that breathes fire on enemies dealing 30% damage per hit.

blazing-scream.d: Send forth a Demon Skull dealing 130% damage as it travels.

sigil-of-chaos.d:
Create a destructive ritual for 10 seconds that grants you Volatility while within.

Killing enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual's chaotic hellfire, increasing the chance for each enemy to explode for 50% damage on death.

dark-prison.d: Create a shadowy totem for 8 seconds that chains enemies, Tethering them to the area and preventing them from escaping.

bombardment.d: Smash down 4 demons into the ground, each dealing 55% damage.

profane-sentinel.d: Summon a demonic eye for 15 seconds that focuses upon enemies with a beam that makes them Vulnerable and periodically blasts them, dealing 180% damage. Recast to direct the eye's targeting.

rampage.d: Summon a rampaging brute for 10 seconds that smashes wildly, dealing 64% damage with a 5% chance per hit to Eviscerate enemies for 1280% damage.

sigil-of-summons.d:
Create a binding ritual for 10 seconds that extends the duration of your Summons.

Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to summon a demon for 20 seconds which attacks nearby enemies, dealing 80% damage per hit.

You can have up to 3 demons active at once.

umbral-chains.d: Send forth a shadowy chain, dealing 80% damage along the way and linking up to 2 enemies for 5 seconds. Enemies caught in the chain are Slowed by 30% and take 25% damage per second.

sigil-of-subversion.d:
Create a subversive ritual for 10 seconds that Hexes enemies.

Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to send forth shadow trails for 8.0 seconds that periodically grant you 1 stack of Shadowform while in them.

You can have up to 3 trails active at once.

wall-of-agony.d: Summon and fuse 5 frenzied demons into a line for 8 seconds. The demons block enemies and flail wildly, dealing 30% damage per hit to those in front of them.

tortured-wretch.d: Summon a tortured demon on your enemies, dealing 60% damage and Taunting them to attack it for 5 seconds.

dread-claws.d: Burst forth 4 shadowy claws, each dealing 70% damage.

tyrants-grasp.d: Summon a demon hand that Pulls enemies away from you, dealing 100% damage.

hell-fracture.d:
Summon the fires of hell to fracture the ground, dealing 80% damage to enemies in the area.

The fractures remain for 15 seconds and explode up to 2 more times when you cast Hell Fracture again.

fiend-of-abaddon.d: Summon a massive fiend for 15 seconds that attacks enemies, dealing 350% damage per swipe.

terror-swarm.d: Summon a terror from the depths that deals 650% damage and spews a voracious swarm that deals 130% damage per bite for 15 seconds.

apocalypse.d:
Create a massive sigil that detonates after 2.0 seconds dealing 666% damage to all enemies within.

This ritual does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction.

metamorphosis.d:
Transform into a demon and gain:
- Demonform
- All Archfiend Demonform Skill Variants
- An Ultimate Archfiend Basic attack that deals 65% damage and generates 5 Dominance

Cast again while active to cancel.

molten-bomb.d: Lob molten lava at an enemy, dealing 75% damage in a small area.

command-fallen.d: Summon a Fallen Lunatic that charges your target and explodes, dealing 80% damage.

doom.d: Burst a sigil on your enemies, Hexing them and dealing 50% damage.

hellion-sting.d: Whip a demon tail forward, dealing 60% damage with a 5% chance to Eviscerate enemies for 600% damage.

sigil-of-subversion-movement-speed.d: Sigil of Subversion trails grant you 20%[x] increased Movement Speed while on them.

sigil-of-subversion-blood-ritual.d: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Subversion's kill costs, up to 48% total.

sigil-of-subversion-cast-range.d: Sigil of Subversion can now be placed at long range.

sigil-of-subversion-slow.d: Sigil of Subversion trails Slow enemies by 75%.

sigil-of-subversion-sigil-of-lava.n: Sigil of Subversion: Sigil of Lava
sigil-of-subversion-sigil-of-lava.d: Sigil of Subversion becomes a Hellfire Skill and now creates lava trails that periodically deal 35% damage. Enemies that die within the trails have a 35% chance to be charred into Brimstones which deal 200% damage when they explode.

sigil-of-subversion-seekers.d: Sigil of Subversion trails teleport Non-Boss enemies back to the ritual area the first time they come in contact.

sigil-of-subversion-infiltration-trails.d: Sigil of Subversion trails now last 50% longer and extend away when you near their ends. While within a trail your Shadowform loses no stacks while moving.

sigil-of-summons-stronger-summons.d: Sigil of Summons deals 25%[x] increased damage but requires 25% more kills per summon.

sigil-of-summons-cooldown.d: Sigil of Summons' active Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when your Greater Demons die.

sigil-of-summons-blood-ritual.d: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly pay each of Sigil of Summons' kill costs, up to 48% total.

sigil-of-summons-damage.d: Enemies within Sigil of Summons take 25%[x] increased damage from your Lesser Demon Skills.

sigil-of-summons-summon-hellwyrm.d: Sigil of Summons now requires 16 kills to summon a Hellwyrm Greater Demon that mimics your Lesser Demon Summon Skill casts by regurgitating related Demons which deal 50% of their normal damage.

sigil-of-summons-feeding-frenzy.d: Sigil of Summons now summons up to 2 additional demons. When Sigil of Summons' demons kill enemies they all gain 3% increased Cast Speed, up to 30%

sigil-of-summons-summon-succubus.d: Sigil of Summons becomes an Abyss Skill and now requires 12 kills to summon up to 2 dark Succubi which fire Abyssal Bloodstars that Weaken enemies, dealing 96% damage and causing enemies to take an additional 240% damage when they try to attack.

sigil-of-chaos-volatility-casts.d: Volatility empowered casts within Sigil of Chaos count as triggering 3 kills.

sigil-of-chaos-chain-reaction.d: Hitting an enemy with Sigil of Chaos has a 20% chance to trigger the effect on them again.

sigil-of-chaos-blood-ritual.d: Sacrifice 4% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Chaos' kill costs, up to 48% total.

sigil-of-chaos-volatility-duration.d: Volatility from Sigil of Chaos now lasts for 10 seconds after you leave the area.

sigil-of-chaos-sigil-of-smoke.n: Sigil of Chaos: Sigil of Smoke
sigil-of-chaos-sigil-of-smoke.d: Sigil of Chaos becomes an Abyss Skill and kills within now send out 2 tendrils of abyssal smoke that deal 60% damage and make enemies Vulnerable. The smoke tendrils pierce through Hexed enemies.

sigil-of-chaos-diabolic-rebuke.d: While you are within Sigil of Chaos, you and your Summons deal 200% damage to enemies when attacked.

sigil-of-chaos-hellfire-aura.d: Sigil of Chaos is now cast around yourself for 15 seconds and instantly explodes your Lesser Demons within for 40% damage. Cooldown increased to 25 seconds.

rampage-killstreak-damage.d: Killing an enemy or Demon with Rampage increases its damage by 20%[x] for 3 seconds, up to 20 seconds.

rampage-lesser-demon-wrath.d: Casting Rampage compels your Lesser Demon Skills to generate 1.0 Wrath per hit for 5 seconds.

rampage-demon-masher.d: Rampage now smashes your Lesser Demons to Fortify you for 2% Maximum Life.

rampage-elite-hit-chance.d: Rampage has a 100% chance to trigger its Eviscerate, Volatility, or Knockdown hit effect when striking unaffected Elite enemies.

rampage-shockwave.d: Each strike from Rampage sends a second smash forward.

rampage-abyssal-titan.d: Rampage becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and summons a larger demon that deals 50%[x] increased damage. Recast to command the demon to leap around the battlefield, dealing 192% damage with a 15% chance per hit to Knock enemies Down for 3 seconds.

rampage-demonic-smash.d: Rampage becomes a Hellfire Mobility leap attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 290% damage with a 5% chance per hit to grant you Volatility for 10 seconds.

profane-sentinel-lesser-demon-vulnerable.d: Casting Profane Sentinel induces your Lesser Demon Skills to make enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

profane-sentinel-single-target-damage.d: Profane Sentinel deals 30%[x] increased damage when it only hits a single target.

profane-sentinel-wide-beam.d: Profane Sentinel's beam area is 200% larger.

profane-sentinel-narrow-blast.d: Profane Sentinel deals 25%[x] increased damage but its blast area is reduced by 50%.

profane-sentinel-focused-glare.d: The longer Profane Sentinel is locked onto the same enemy the stronger it becomes, dealing 25% more damage every second.

profane-sentinel-demonic-sight.d: Profane Sentinel becomes a Hellfire eye blast attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 414% damage and Weakening enemies.

profane-sentinel-sentry.d: You can now summon multiple Profane Sentinels but can no longer redirect their gaze. Profane Sentinels deal 126% damage and fire extra blasts at any Nearby Stealthed enemies.

tyrants-grasp-unstoppable-damage.d: Tyrant's Grasp deals 100%[x] increased damage against Unstoppable enemies.

tyrants-grasp-lesser-demon-slow.d: Casting Tyrant's Grasp commands your Lesser Demon Skills to Slow enemies by 60% for 5 seconds.

tyrants-grasp-grasp-area.d: Tyrant's Grasp's area is increased by 100% and Pulls in Brimstone.

tyrants-grasp-knock-down.d: Tyrant's Grasp Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.

tyrants-grasp-abyssal-pit.d: Tyrant's Grasp becomes an Abyss Recast Summon Skill and summons an Abyssal Pit for 10 seconds that consumes Non-Elite enemies, dealing 350% damage, Knocking them down, and hiding them in Stealth. Recast to Pull additional targets into the Pit. Tyrant's Grasp now costs 20 Dominance.

tyrants-grasp-demonic-grasp.d: Tyrant's Grasp becomes a direct grasp attack that transforms you into Demonform and Pulls enemies inward.

tyrants-grasp-inescapable-grapple.d: Tyrant's Grasp repeatedly reaches for you and Pulls away enemies for 5 seconds.

infernal-breath-ramping-damage.d: Enemies permanently take 1%[x] increased damage from Infernal Breath each time it hits them, up to 25%[x].

infernal-breath-lesser-demon-volatility.d: Casting Infernal Breath infuses your Lesser Demon Skills to grant 1 seconds of Volatility per hit for 5 seconds.

infernal-breath-heavy-impact-damage.d: Infernal Breath no longer pierces but deals 2000%[x] increased damage the first time it hits an enemy every 10 seconds.

infernal-breath-expensive-damage.d: Infernal Breath deals 140%[x] increased damage but costs 100% more Dominance.

infernal-breath-demonic-breath.d: Infernal Breath becomes a Channeled fire breath attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 60% damage per hit. Infernal Breath's cost is reduced by 50% while you have Volatility.

infernal-breath-explosive-death.d: At the end of Infernal Breath the demon explodes, dealing 200% damage. The explosion damage is increased by 20%[x] for each time the demon's breath hit enemies.

infernal-breath-abyssal-torrent.d: Infernal Breath becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and summons a larger demon for 15 seconds that Executes Hexed enemies. Recast to aim and blast enemies 3 times for 200% damage.

dark-prison-missile-slow.d: Small Missiles that enter Dark Prison are Slowed by 99%.

dark-prison-fortify.d: Hitting enemies within Dark Prison Fortifies you for 1% Maximum Life.

dark-prison-cooldown-reduction.d: Enemies killed within Dark Prison reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

dark-prison-weaken.d: Enemies within Dark Prison are Weakened.

dark-prison-tripwire.d: Casting Dark Prison refreshes and creates a link to your last prison, enemies that cross the line will be Pulled into the new prison. Dark Prison gains an additional charge.

dark-prison-chain-aura.d: Dark Prison becomes a Hellfire Skill and now creates an aura of fire chains around you, reducing damage coming from outside by 45% and Slowing enemies within by 80%.

dark-prison-calamity-cage.d: Dark Prison is now additionally a Recast Sigil Skill and lasts 50% longer but you can only have one at a time. When the prison ends all enemies within take 200% damage, increased by 100%[x] per additional enemy within. Non-Elite enemies within the prison cannot die while it is active. Recast to collapse the prison early.

tortured-wretch-enrage.d: When enemies attack the Tortured Wretch they are enraged for 2 seconds, gaining 100%[+] increased Attack Speed but taking 25% damage when they hit targets.

tortured-wretch-duration.d: Enemies and Demons killed Close to the Tortured Wretch extend its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.

tortured-wretch-cost-reduction.d: Tortured Wretch cost is reduced by 30%.

tortured-wretch-unstoppable.d: Casting Tortured Wretch makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

tortured-wretch-domination.d: Tortured Wretch becomes an Abyss Occult Recast Skill and now directly dominates a target's mind for up to 15 seconds, forcing it to Taunt your enemies and take 50% damage when hit by them. Recast to command the target around the battlefield.

tortured-wretch-death-saws.d: Saws grind up enemies around the Tortured Wretch, periodically dealing 20% damage with a 5% chance to Eviscerate enemies for 600% damage.

tortured-wretch-punching-bag.d: Tortured Wretch no longer Taunts but now lasts for 12 seconds and you redirect all damage to it so long as you stay in the area. It can absorb up to 30% of your Maximum Life before it is killed. When the demon dies it explodes, dealing up to 500% damage and Fortifying you for up to 25% based on the damage it absorbed.

wall-of-agony-damage.d: Wall of Agony deals 2 increased damage for every point of Maximum Dominance you have.

wall-of-agony-small-walls.d: Wall of Agony now only spawns 3 demons but its cost is reduced by 50%.

wall-of-agony-cost-reduction.d: Wall of Agony's cost is reduced by 50% but increased by 10% for every Demon you have active.

wall-of-agony-knock-down.d: Each hit from Wall of Agony has a 20% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds.

wall-of-agony-waller.d: Wall of Agony summons 10 demons in a cage formation that Pulls enemies inward.

wall-of-agony-fallen-army.d: When Wall of Agony expires, demon brutes remain for 8 seconds and attack Nearby enemies. If Wall of Agony is killed early then the demon brutes gain its remaining duration.

wall-of-agony-encircle.d: Wall of Agony is summoned in an encircling formation that Knocks enemies Back. Each active Wall of Agony demon grants you 6% Damage Reduction, up to 30%. Wall of Agony now has a 20 second Cooldown but costs no Dominance.

nether-step-damage-reduction.d: Nether Step grants 60% Damage Reduction that decays alongside its Movement Speed Bonus.

nether-step-extra-charge.d: Nether Step gains an additional Charge.

nether-step-movement-speed.d: Nether Step's Movement Speed Bonus lasts 50% longer.

nether-step-vacuum-swap.d: Nether Step sucks enemies into its exit portal and swaps places with them.

nether-step-portals.d: Nether Step's portals remain for 10 seconds and can be re-entered to move back and forth.

nether-step-gloomwalker.d: Nether Step now lets you run through the abyss while Immune for up to 3 seconds. Cast again to exit early.

nether-step-shadow-recall.d: Nether Step brings all your Abyss Summons with you through the shadows and extends their durations by 3 seconds.

umbral-chains-heavy-harpoon.d: Umbral Chains Knocks Back your primary target and deals 50%[x] increased damage to them.

umbral-chains-wrath-refund.d: When Umbral Chains ends it refunds 1 Wrath for every enemy hit over its duration.

umbral-chains-capture-damage.d: Umbral Chains deals 20%[x] increased damage when an unchained enemy is first caught by the chain. Hexed enemies always take increased damage.

umbral-chains-long-range-slow.d: Umbral Chains flies 50% farther and its Slow is increased to 60%.

umbral-chains-chain-burst.d: Umbral Chains explodes for 94% damage when stretched to its maximum or when it expires. If this happens early then any damage the chain would have done is added.

umbral-chains-chain-whips.d: Umbral Chains becomes a Hellfire Skill and whips around your target, dealing 44% damage per second to surrounding enemies and striking a 25% larger area when empowered by Volatility.

umbral-chains-epicenter.d: Umbral Chains now always creates a chain link back to you. Additionally, a chain is created between you and each Greater Demon Summon for up to 30 seconds.

hell-fracture-ramp-up.d: Casting a Basic Skill increases the damage of your next Hell Fracture by 40%[x] but also increases the Cost by 25%, up to 4 times.

hell-fracture-cost-reduction.d: Casting Hell Fracture reduces its cost by 25% until you Cast a different Skill.

hell-fracture-volatility.d: Standing within a Hell Fracture explosion grants you Volatility for 3 seconds.

hell-fracture-eruption.d: Hell Fracture no longer explodes with each cast and instead creates 3 smaller fractures in front of you that erupt into 5 Brimstones when you enter. Each Brimstone deals 60% damage when it explodes.

hell-fracture-lava-fissures.d: Hell Fracture creates lava fissures between each fracture which burst for 80% damage.

hell-fracture-ruptured-abyss.d: Hell Fracture becomes an Abyss Skill and now reaches to the abyss, dealing 112% damage and Pulling Hexed enemies inwards.

blazing-scream-impact-velocity.d: Blazing Scream gains up to 30%[x] increased damage and speed based on your Movement Speed Bonus.

blazing-scream-brimstone-hunger.d: Blazing Scream's primary skulls instantly detonate Brimstone as they travel, increasing that skull's damage by 5% per Brimstone, up to 50%.

blazing-scream-cost-reduction.d: Hitting any enemy with Blazing Scream reduces its cost by 25% for 2 seconds.

blazing-scream-damage.d: Blazing Scream deals 3%[x] increased damage based on how many different enemies it has hit, up to 30%[x].

blazing-scream-skull-splitter.d: Blazing Scream shoots out smaller Lesser Demon Skulls that seek enemies and deal 29% damage.

blazing-scream-abyssal-oppression.d: Blazing Scream becomes an Abyss Recast Summon Skill, seeking your target location for 5 seconds and Knocking Down enemies the first time it hits them. Enemies near the skull take 228% damage and become Vulnerable. Channeling redirects the skull and refreshes the duration.

blazing-scream-orbital-scream.d: Blazing Scream is now also a Summon Skill and orbits you for 10 seconds. The skull deals 384% damage and extends Demonform when it hits enemies. Channeling increases the orbit speed by 150% and refreshes the duration.

dread-claws-ambush.d: Dread Claws deals 50%[x] increased damage with its first claw strike against each enemy. When attacking from Stealth all claws gain this bonus.

dread-claws-vulnerable.d: Dread Claws makes enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds if it strikes them at least 2 times.

dread-claws-damage.d: Every second, gain 20%[x] increased damage for your next Dread Claws, up to 100%[x].

dread-claws-cost-reduction.d: Killing enemies or demons with Dread Claws reduces the cost of your next Dread Claws by 10%, up to 50%.

dread-claws-ravenous-jaws.d: Dread Claws becomes a Lesser Demon Skill and is cast in a frontal cone, dealing 88% damage and killing up to 5 Lesser Demons it strikes. Each Lesser Demon killed grants Dread Claws a 2%[+] chance for 10 seconds to Eviscerate enemies for 700% damage, up to 10%[+].

dread-claws-enveloping-terror.d: Dread Claws are cast around you, each dealing 116% damage. You consume 1 stack of Shadowform to also conjure claws around your most recent Greater Demon Summon.

dread-claws-cascading-dread.d: Dread Claws sends out 4 additional claws and each set deals 30%[x] increased damage than the last.

bombardment-damage.d: Each cast of Bombardment deals 5% increased damage to each enemy per hit.

bombardment-focused-target.d: Bombardment's chaotic spread is reduced by 300% and it deals 30% increased damage when only hitting a single enemy.

bombardment-telekinesis.d: Each time Bombardment throws a demon it has a 100% chance to also throw a surrounding Lesser Demon at your target location.

bombardment-endless-barrage.d: Bombardment becomes a Hellfire Skill and now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for 10 seconds afterward. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

bombardment-demon-mangler.d: Each Bombardment impact now has a 40% chance to leave behind mutilated demons for 8 seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing 28% damage.

bombardment-brutality.d: Each cast of Bombardment within 3 seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to 4 additional.

metamorphosis-damage-scaling.d: Metamorphosis increases your Demonology Skill damage by 1 for each 1200 bonus Maximum Life you have.

metamorphosis-stagger-bar.d: Metamorphosis makes you Unstoppable but each time you would be Incapacitated you take 10 Stagger. You recover from 1 Stagger per second but if you reach 100 Stagger you are Stunned for 5 seconds.

metamorphosis-dominance.d: Metamorphosis reduces your Dominance Costs by 20%.

metamorphosis-sin-demon.d: During Metamorphosis your Maximum Wrath and Dominance are increased by 50%[+] and you deal 5 increased damage for each Demon Summon you have active. When you leave Metamorphosis, casting Summon Skills reduces its Cooldown by 2 seconds.

metamorphosis-destruction-demon.d: Metamorphosis does not replace any Skills and grants Volatility while active. Each Skill cast increases your Hellfire damage by 6.00 but Burns you for 8% Maximum Life over 3 seconds. Each Cast deals 5% increased Burning to you and Metamorphosis ends if you become Injured or cancel early.

metamorphosis-terror-demon.d: Metamorphosis becomes an Abyss Skill that does not replace any Skills and lasts for 15.00 seconds. Metamorphosis grants 4 Shadowform stacks every second and Abyss Skills do not break its Stealth while active.

terror-swarm-vulnerable.d: Terror Swarm makes enemies Vulnerable and causes them to take 40% increased damage from your Archfiend Skills.

terror-swarm-extra-bites.d: Terror Swarm now bites up to 2 additional times per second.

terror-swarm-lesser-demons.d: Terror Swarm spawns and instantly kills 3 Lesser Demons every second.

terror-swarm-pull.d: Terror Swarm periodically Pulls enemies into the center of the swarm.

terror-swarm-nightmare.d: Terror Swarm is now additionally a Recast Skill and stays in place, dealing 260% damage per hit. Recast while active to command the swarm to move to your target.

terror-swarm-searing-infestation.d: Terror Swarm becomes a Hellfire Skill and stays around you, dealing 221% damage per hit.

terror-swarm-devouring-swarm.d: Terror Swarm starts smaller and weaker but grows up to 3 times as it feeds on enemies. Upon reaching maximum size, swarms split off another smaller swarm. Can have up to 3 active swarms.

apocalypse-double-blast.d: Apocalypse's final hit has a 20% chance to hit twice. When Apocalypse is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%.

apocalypse-epicenter-damage.d: Apocalypse deals up to 25%[x] increased damage the closer enemies are to its center.

apocalypse-shared-damage.d: Apocalypse's final hit deals an additional 50% of its damage split amongst all enemies in the area.

apocalypse-survivor-damage.d: Enemies that survive Apocalypse take 25%[x] increased damage from you for 3 seconds. This bonus lasts 200% longer against Hexed enemies.

apocalypse-minefield.d: Apocalypse becomes an Abyss Skill, creating a field of Abyssal Mines which arm after 0.8 seconds and each deal 666% damage when an enemy triggers them.

apocalypse-armageddon-ritual.d: You can now Channel Apocalypse for up to 6.66 seconds to build up the final explosion and rain down Brimstones which deal 666% damage. Each second increases the final damage, up to 666% bonus damage.

apocalypse-annihilation.d: Apocalypse launches a hellfire blast with at least 20 Stacks that deals 33% damage. Hellfire Skill hits generate up to 100 Stacks, each Stack increases the blast's explosion size and damage by 40%[x].

fiend-of-abaddon-elite-damage.d: Fiend of Abaddon deals 25%[x] increased damage against Elite enemies and Bosses.

fiend-of-abaddon-dominance.d: Fiend of Abaddon now costs 30 Dominance and has no Cooldown.

fiend-of-abaddon-crowd-damage.d: Fiend of Abaddon deals 2%[x] increased damage for each Nearby enemy present when it is summoned, up to 60%[x].

fiend-of-abaddon-lesser-demon-bonus.n: Fiend of Abaddon: Lesser Demon Bonus
fiend-of-abaddon-lesser-demon-bonus.d: Each active Fiend of Abaddon increases your Lesser Demon Skill damage by 30%[x].

fiend-of-abaddon-vanguard-of-flames.n: Fiend of Abaddon: Vanguard of Flames
fiend-of-abaddon-vanguard-of-flames.d: Fiend of Abaddon becomes a Hellfire Skill and now summons a demon for 20 seconds that moves with you and attacks for 630% damage per swipe.

fiend-of-abaddon-abyssal-colossus.d: Fiend of Abaddon becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and now summons a demon for 30 seconds that attacks for 455% damage per swipe. Recast to command the demon to do a massive smash that Pulls in enemies and explodes for 700% damage.

fiend-of-abaddon-spiteful-enrage.d: If an enemy survives more than 5 hits from Fiend of Abaddon then each subsequent hit increases its damage versus that target by 5%[x] and extends its lifetime by 2 seconds, up to 60 seconds.

hellion-sting-eviscerate.d: Hellion Sting has 40%[x] increased Eviscerate chance against your primary target.

hellion-sting-fortify.d: When you strike an Eviscerated enemy with Hellion Sting you are Fortified for 1% Maximum Life.

hellion-sting-wrath.d: Casting Hellion Sting increases your Wrath Regeneration by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 30%.

hellion-sting-damage.d: Hellion Sting deals 50%[x] increased damage to enemies for 3 seconds after you first strike them with it.

hellion-sting-demonic-swipe.d: Hellion Sting becomes a Greater Demon Hellfire Archfiend Skill and its 4th attack transforms you into Demonform, cleaving a wide area for 180% damage.

hellion-sting-tail-spikes.d: Hellion Sting launches a wave of spikes forward a long distance dealing 53% damage per hit.

hellion-sting-multi-strike.d: Casting Hellion Sting within 1.5 seconds of the last will increase the number of strikes, up to 2 total hits per cast.

command-fallen-damage-per-demon.d: Command Fallen deals 1%[x] increased damage for every Demon you have active, up to 20%[x].

command-fallen-wrath.d: Command Fallen generates 1 additional Wrath for every Demon or Enemy you have killed in the last 2 seconds, up to 5 additional Wrath.

command-fallen-dominance.d: Every 15 times you hit enemies with Command Fallen you gain 1 Dominance.

command-fallen-lifetime-damage.d: Your Demons summoned by Command Fallen deal 8%[x] increased damage for every second they are alive, up to 30%[x].

command-fallen-mega-lunatic.d: Command Fallen summons a Mega Lunatic which deals 136% damage and bursts into 3 Mini Lunatics which each deal 40% damage.

command-fallen-fallen-rush.d: Command Fallen is also an Abyss Skill and now summons up to 3 Fallen Grunts for 30 seconds which deal 48% damage and generate 10 Wrath per hit. Recasting while all are active will direct them to move or target on your command.

command-fallen-meat-shields.d: Command Fallen becomes a Hellfire Skill and passively summons a Lunatic every 1.0 seconds that follows you around and detonates when enemies get close, up to 5 Lunatics. Summon rate is based on your Attack Speed.

doom-assimilation.d: Casting Doom against a Vulnerable, Weakened, or Slowed enemy assimilates the effects, causing Doom to also apply those effects for 3 seconds.

doom-echo.d: Casting Doom echoes 10% of its damage to all Nearby Hexed enemies.

doom-wrath.d: Doom generates 1 Wrath every 2 seconds for each Hexed enemy.

doom-damage.d: Doom deals 2%[x] increased damage to enemies for each second they have been Hexed, up to 200%[x].

doom-doomfire-ritual.d: Doom becomes a Hellfire Skill and your Hex is applied with Maximum Stacks for 15 seconds but you can only have one Hexed target at a time. When Hex expires or is removed, Doom deals 250% damage split amongst all enemies in the area as a Sigil Skill.

doom-contagion.d: Whenever you kill a Hexed enemy, Doom spreads the Hex to another enemy and deals 50% damage to them.

doom-jailer.d: Doom is cast at range on the ground, leaving behind a mark that Tethers your Primary Target and Hexes enemies within for 6 seconds.

molten-bomb-ranged-damage.d: Molten Bomb deals up to 39.6%[x] increased damage based on how far it travels.

molten-bomb-wrath.d: Molten Bomb generates 1 additional Wrath on each impact.

molten-bomb-knock-down.d: Molten Bomb has a 15% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds. When Molten Bomb is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%. Can occur once every 4 seconds per enemy.

molten-bomb-area-bonus.d: Molten Bomb's impact area is increased by 30% and does 30%[x] increased damage to enemies at its center.

molten-bomb-brimstone-mortar.d: Molten Bomb creates a Brimstone at the impact location which deals 56% damage when it explodes.

molten-bomb-demon-turret.d: Molten Bomb becomes a Demonology Summon Skill and creates a turret demon on impact for 5 seconds that spits lava at surrounding enemies, each dealing 49% damage. You can have up to 6 turrets active at a once.

molten-bomb-cluster-bomb.d: Molten Bomb becomes an Abyss Skill and now lobs a cluster of 6 smaller shadow orbs which each deal 34% damage. Casting another Molten Bomb splits the previous cluster midflight into a wider impact. If the cluster is not split it instead creates a shadow zone for 7 seconds that grants 4 stacks of Shadowform every second.

prickleskin.d: Deal 15% increased damage to enemies for 5 seconds after they attack you.

gift-of-the-stag.d: Gain 30 Maximum Spirit. You gain 5 Spirit every second.
