advantageous-beast.d: Gain 15%[+] Movement Speed and 15%[+] Impairment Reduction.

scythe-talons.d: Gain 10%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance and 15%[x] increased Lucky Hit Chance.

pack-leader.d: **Lucky Hit:** Critical Strikes have up to a 15.0% chance to reset the Cooldowns of your Companion Skills.

energize.d: **Lucky Hit:** Dealing damage has up to a 15% chance to restore 15 Spirit.

bolster.d: Defensive Skills gain 40% increased Cooldown Reduction Rate while you are Fortified. This Rate is split amongst each equipped Defensive Skill.

calamity.d: Extend the duration of Ultimate Skills by 35%.

obsidian-slam.d: Casting an Earth Skill grants 1 stack of Resolve. Gaining or losing Resolve increases the damage Earth Skills deal by 20%[x] for 4 seconds.

overload.d:
**Lucky Hit:** Storm Skills have up to a 20% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity.

Storm Skills gain 15%[+] increased Cast Speed while you have Ferocity.

masochistic.d:
**Lucky Hit:** Critical Strikes with Shapeshifting Skills have up to a 30% chance to grant Berserking for 4 seconds.

Berserking increases the damage of Shapeshifting Skills by 10%[x].

calm-before-the-storm.d: **Lucky Hit:** Nature Magic Skills have up to a 10% chance to reduce the Cooldown of your Ultimate Skill by 2 seconds.

1h-axe.d:
10.0%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance against Injured enemies. Double this amount when using two Axes.

**Lucky Hit:** Critical Strikes have up to a 55% chance to grant 6%[+] increased Attack Speed for 2 seconds. Double the Attack Speed bonus when using two Axes.

1h-mace.d:
10%[x] increased damage to Stunned enemies. Double this amount when using two Maces.

**Lucky Hit:** Up to a 10% chance to gain Berserking for 3.00 seconds when you hit a Stunned enemy. Double this chance when using two Maces.

1h-sword.d:
**Lucky Hit:** Up to a 10% chance to gain 5 Fury when hitting a Crowd Controlled enemy. Double this chance when using two Swords.

Killing a Crowd Controlled enemy grants 15%[+] increased Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Double this amount when using two Swords.

2h-axe.d:
10.0%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance against Vulnerable enemies.

2h-mace.d:
**Lucky Hit:** Up to 10% chance to gain 5 Fury when hitting an enemy. Double the amount of Fury gained while Berserking.

You deal 15%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage while Berserking.

polearm.d:
15.0%[x] increased Lucky Hit Chance.

You deal 15.0%[x] increased damage while Healthy.

2h-sword.d:
20%[+] of direct damage you deal is inflicted as Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

You deal 15%[x] increased Bleeding damage.

combo-points.d: Your Basic Skills now generate Combo Points. Core Skills Consume Combo Points for additional effects.

preparation.d: Spend 75 Energy to reduce your Ultimate Skill's Cooldown by 5 seconds. Ultimate Skills grant 15% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.

inner-sight.d: Attack enemies to fill your Inner Sight gauge. Marked enemies fill it faster. When full, restore 300 Energy, and gain 100% Energy Cost Reduction, 25%[+] Critical Strike Chance, and 25%[x] Critical Strike Damage for 4 seconds.

skeletal-warriors-skirmishers.d:
Skirmishers slice up enemies, dealing high damage to a single target. Skeleton Warrior is also a Bone Skill.
You can raise 2 additional Skirmishers. Whenever a Skirmisher is Summoned, you automatically command them to leap at a nearby enemy and attack.
Skirmishers slice up enemies, making them Vulnerable and Slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.
Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by 7%[+], but …

skeletal-warriors-defenders.d:
Defenders are durable protectors, dealing less damage but retaining strong survivability. Skeleton Warrior is also a Blood Skill.
Defenders gain [X] Thorns. Whenever they are damaged, their bones splinter and deal 50% of their Thorns to nearby enemies. Commanding your Defenders causes them to Taunt nearby enemies for 6 seconds.
Defenders have a 10% chance to form a Blood Orb when they deal damage.…

skeletal-warriors-reapers.d:
Reapers wield a powerful cleaving scythe and have a wind-up attack that deals heavy damage every 10 seconds. Skeleton Warrior is also a Darkness Skill.
Reaper's wind-up attacks now reduce one of your active Cooldowns by 3 seconds and form a Corpse.
Reapers deal 50%[x] increased damage and have a 15% chance to Stun enemies for 1 second.
You deal 22.28%[x] increased damage, but the amount of Reapers…

skeletal-mages-shadow.d:
Shadow Mages wield power from the beyond, firing bursting shadow bolts. Skeleton Mage is also a Darkness Skill.
Shadow Mages deal an additional 100% Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.
Shadow Mages' bolts grant you and the Shadow Mage a Barrier for 3.0% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds, up to 30%.
Your Essence Regeneration is increased by 29.7%[+] and your maximum Essence is increased by 30, but t…

skeletal-mages-cold.d:
Cold Mages attacks will chill enemies, eventually freezing them in their tracks. Skeleton Mage is also a Darkness Skill.
Cold Mages' initial projectile forks into 2 projectiles on impact. Enemies damaged by Cold Mages are Weakened for 4 seconds.
Cold Mages occasionally cast a blizzard that deals 200% Cold damage over 6 seconds and Chills for 6% every second. Enemies damaged by Cold Mages are made …

skeletal-mages-bone.d:
Bone Mages use their own bodies as piercing projectiles, dealing heavy damage at the cost of their own Life. Skeleton Mage is also a Bone Skill.
Bone Mages fire 2 additional projectiles that deal 75% of normal damage.
Bone Mages' attacks Fortify you for 3.0% of your Maximum Life. Bone Mages form a Corpse when they die.
You deal 29.7%[x] increased damage while you have a stack of Overpower, but the…

golems-bone.d:
Bone Golem taunts enemies, forcing them to attack it and retaliating with deadly Thorns. Golem is also a Bone Skill.
Commanding your Bone Golem causes it to form 5 corpses.
When your Bone Golem takes damage, it unleashes bone spikes dealing 250% damage. This effect can occur once every 3 seconds. Enemies damaged by Bone Golem are made Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
You gain 15%[+] increased Attack Spee…

golems-blood.d:
Blood Golem drains Life from nearby enemies, healing and bolstering itself. Golem is also a Blood Skill.
Commanding your Blood Golem also causes it to drain Life from your other Minions, increasing its Maximum Life by 5% and damage by 5%[x] per Minion drained for 20 seconds, up to 50% increased Maximum Life and 50%[x] increased damage.
When you command your Blood Golem, you Fortify for 10% of your…

golems-iron.d:
Iron Golem wields immense weight and power, Stunning and controlling enemies. Golem is also a Darkness Skill.
Every Iron Golem attack causes a shockwave, dealing 125% damage to the primary enemy and to enemies behind them.
Your Iron Golem's slam attack Pulls In enemies and its Size is increased by 50%.
You deal 22.28%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage, but your Golem does 50%[x] less damage.

jaguar.d:
Every 15th time you deal direct damage with a Jaguar Skill, unleash a Beat Strike dealing 23% damage, increasing all damage you deal by 3%[x] and doubling each subsequent Beat Strike's damage, stacking 5 times. You lose all stacks when you stop attacking for 1 second.

All Skills are now also Jaguar Skills.

eagle.d:
Casting an Eagle Skill or Evading shoots 2 Storm Feathers, each dealing 13% Lightning damage and applying Vulnerable for 5 seconds. Can only occur once every 0.5 seconds. The Storm Feathers Movement Speed bonus is doubled and always active.

All Skills are now also Eagle Skills.

gorilla.d:
Attacking with a Gorilla Skill deals 150% Thorns to enemies you hit and grants a Barrier for 2.5% of Maximum Life for 3 seconds.

All Skills are now also Gorilla Skills.

centipede.d:
Hitting an enemy with a Centipede Skill reduces their Damage by 4, Slows them by 10%, and deals 58% Poisoning damage over 8 seconds, stacking up to 8 times.

All Skills are now also Centipede Skills.

zealot.d:
Casting Zealot Skills grants Fervor for 2 seconds. Critically Striking with these Skills echoes the attack for an additional 35% of the damage, repeating for each stack of Fervor.

While at maximum Fervor, additionally Fortify for 1% of your Maximum Life.

juggernaut.d:
Casting a Juggernaut Skill consumes 8 stacks of Resolve, giving your Juggernaut Skills 100%[x] increased damage and gain 20% increased size for 5 seconds.

Your Minimum Resolve is increased by 1 and is no longer consumed when getting hit.

judicator.d:
Your Basic Skills now apply Judgement.

Judgement can now be detonated early by your Core Judicator Skills, dealing 80% weapon damage in a small area and gaining Judicator Skill benefits. If Judgement only hits one enemy, it deals 100%[x] increased damage.

Judging an enemy, increase the damage they take from you by 80%[x] until they die.

disciple.d:
Casting a Disciple Skill with a cooldown grants Arbiter for 4.5 seconds.

Wing Strikes gain Disciple Skill benefits.

While in Arbiter form, your Disciple Skills deal 100%[x] increased damage.

summon-aegrom.d:
**Passive**: Ae'grom cleaves with its arms, dealing 75% damage, and spawns a Vile Child Lesser Demon every 0.5 second.

**Active**: Command Ae'grom to explode all of your Lesser Demons, dealing 150% damage each.

summon-abodian.d:
**Passive**: Abodian bites and claws enemies that get Close to you, dealing 245% damage.

**Active**: Command Abodian to enter Demonform for 5.5 seconds and mount Abodian, becoming Unstoppable and gaining 80%[x] increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds. While mounted, chain enemies and Pull them behind you, dealing 25% damage every 0.5 seconds. After you dismount, Abodian slams the ground, dealing 2…

summon-laalish.d:
**Passive**: Laalish seeks enemies and applies Vulnerable, Weaken, and a 30% Slow to Close enemies that lingers for 4 seconds. When you attack enemies, it moves through the abyss to bite them, dealing 300% damage.

**Active**: Command Laalish to create a Terror Realm for 6 seconds, applying Vulnerable, Weaken, and a 60% Slow to enemies within. Laalish devours enemies within Terror Realm, dealing 1…

summon-valloch.d:
**Passive:** Valloch increases your Maximum Overpower by 2 and Maximum Wrath by 40.

**Active**: Command Valloch to siphon its power to overfill your Overpower by 1 and increase Wrath Regeneration by 100%[+] for 10 seconds.

coat-of-arms.d: Your damage is increased by 75% of your Armor Percent and 50% of your Block Chance.

path-of-the-penitent.d: Your Zealot Skills cost 100% more Faith, but Casting them grants all Skills +6% Resource Cost Reduction and x12% increased damage for 4 seconds, up to 10 times.

exaltation.d: During Arbiter your damage is increased by x85% and Wing Strikes strike 1 additional time.

judgement-day.d:
Consuming Judgement increases your damage by x6% for 5 seconds, up to x90%.
Judgement now spreads to nearby targets without Judgement when it detonates.

raise-skeleton.d:
You Raise a Skeleton from a Corpse to fight for you.

Once all of your Skeletons have been summoned, Raise Skeleton briefly summons a Skeletal Priest to empower your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their damage by 30% and healing them for 25% of their Maximum Life.

chain-lightning-cost-reduction.d: Each time Crackling Energy hits an enemy, the Mana cost of your next Chain Lightning is reduced by 1.

ravager-ferocity-minimum.d: Ravager's Passive further increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 more.

rushing-claw-charge-refund.d: Using Rushing Claw's last Charge will refill 4 Charges by consuming 4 stacks of Ferocity.

blazing-scream-knock-down.d: Blazing Scream Knocks Down enemies for 1 seconds the first time it hits them.

blazing-scream-direct-control.d: Blazing Scream now seeks your target location for 5 seconds, dealing 478% damage and making enemies Vulnerable. Channeling redirects the skull and refreshes the duration. Blazing Scream is now an Abyss Skill.

blazing-scream-orbital.d: Blazing Scream now orbits you for 10 seconds. The skull deals 805% damage and extends Demonform when it hits enemies. Channeling increases the orbit speed by 150% and refreshes the duration.

tyrants-grasp-slow.d: Casting Tyrant's Grasp commands your Lesser Demon Skills to Slow enemies by 60% for 5 seconds.

profane-sentinel-vulnerable.d: Casting Profane Sentinel induces your Lesser Demon Skills to make enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

metamorphosis-phase-2-enrage.d: Metamorphosis grants x40% increased damage when you are reduced below half your Maximum Life but you also cannot Heal above this threshold.

hammer-of-the-ancients-furious.d: Hammer of the Ancients gain 5% Critical Strike Damage and Critical Strike Chance for every 10 Fury you had when cast. Its Critical Strikes Knockdown enemies for 2 seconds.

withering-fist-enhanced.d: You gain 1 Vigor per second for every Nearby enemy Poisoned by Withering Fist, up to 10.

withering-fist-sharp.d: Withering Fist's 3rd attack spreads its Poisoning to 5 Nearby unaffected enemies. Hitting a Vulnerable enemy will also spread that effect to all hit.

withering-fist-accelerated.d: Enemies Poisoned by Withering Fist deal 20% less damage.

thrash-enhanced.d: After killing an enemy, your next Thrash generates 10 additional Vigor, up to 10 casts of Thrash.

thrash-sharp.d: Thrash's 3rd attack grants a 2 stacks of Ferocity.

thrash-accelerated.d: Thrash continues to unleash its 3rd attack if cast again within 1.5 seconds.

quill-volley-enhanced.d: Quill Volley makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds if they are hit with at least 3 feathers at once.

quill-volley-advantageous.d: Quill Volley hurls out 3 additonal feathers and deals x10% increased damage to each enemy per hit.

quill-volley-rampant.d: Quill Volley's feathers fly 50% further and converge on your target with +0.20% additional Critical Strike Chance for each point of Vigor you had on cast.

rake-enhanced.d: Casting Rake grants a stack of Ferocity.

rake-advantageous.d: Hitting at least one enemy with Rake reduces your longest active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

rake-rampant.d: Rake's Vigor cost is reduced by 2 per stack of Ferocity you have.

stinger-enhanced.d: Stinger applies 60% of its Base damage as Poisoning over 6 seconds to all enemies hit.

stinger-advantageous.d: If Stinger strikes a Vulnerable enemy it Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life. If you are Healthy it makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

stinger-rampant.d: Stinger does x40% increased damage if it only hits a single enemy. Instead of echoing to surrounding Poisoned enemies, Stinger now draws from each to hit enemies in the primary area again for an additional 10% of its Base damage.

ravager-enhanced.d: Ravager's duration is extended by 2 seconds per kill while active. This bonus is reduced by 0.25 each kill, to a minimum of 0.25 seconds.

ravager-measured.d: While Ravager is active, your Core Skills instantly dash to your target and all Vigor Generation is increased by x30%.

ravager-replenishing.d: Ravager passively stockpiles any Healing you receive up to 40 stacks. While active, Ravager spends stacks to strike Elite enemies up to an additonal 4 times.

toxic-skin-enhanced.d: While active, Toxic Skin's Poisoning is increased by 130% over 3 seconds.

toxic-skin-measured.d: While Toxic Skin is active, you deal an additional 36% Poison Damage as Critical Strikes to Nearby Vulnerable Poisoned enemies every second.

toxic-skin-replenishing.d: Toxic Skin passively increases Thorns damage you deal to Poisoned enemies by x100%.

armored-hide-enhanced.d: Activating Armored Hide grants you Maximum Resolve and increases your Thorns by [X] for the duration.

armored-hide-adaptable.d: When you Evade through enemies with Armored Hide active, you deal 100% of your Thorns to them and Heal for 5% of your Maximum Life per hit.

armored-hide-reinforced.d: While active, Armored Hide increases your Blocked Damage Reduction by +5% for every Nearby enemy, up to +20%.

concussive-stomp-enhanced.d: Concussive Stomp grants a Barrier equal to 10% of your Maximum Life per enemy hit for 3 seconds, up to 40%.

concussive-stomp-adaptable.d: When enemies recover from a Concussive Stomp that you Cast, you block their next 3 attacks.

concussive-stomp-reinforced.d: Concussive Stomp gains an additional Charge and does x600% increased damage to Unstoppable enemies and Bosses.

payback-enhanced.d: Each time an enemy attacks you the damage they take from Payback is increased by x20% for 60 seconds, up to x200%.

payback-poised.d: Payback passively grants you Vigor when you take damage. Payback is now a Core Skill and Consumes all available Vigor to increase its damage by x0.5% for each point Consumed.

payback-invasive.d: Becoming Control Impaired while Payback is on Cooldown makes it free to cast and grants you Unstoppable for 5 seconds. Can only occur once every 8 seconds.

razor-wings-enhanced.d: Razor Wings makes enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds when hitting with a Critical Strike or from behind.

razor-wings-poised.d: Razor Wings has a 10% chance to regain a Charge when they hit an enemy. Double this chance if you have an active Barrier.

razor-wings-invasive.d: Razor Wings lasts 300% longer and spiral outwards.

the-protector-harmonious.d: The Protector's strikes deal x350% increased damage and all enemies within its area deal 30% reduced damage.

the-protector-exalted.d: The Protector's area persists for an additional 6 seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by 80%. While it's Nearby, you are Unstoppable and deal 30% increased damage.

the-seeker-harmonious.d: The Seeker's first hit Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds. Both its first and second hits are guaranteed to Critically Strike.

the-seeker-exalted.d: The Seeker constantly makes all Nearby enemies Vulnerable while active.

the-hunter-harmonious.d:
The Hunter overfills your Ferocity by 2 stacks and causes you to deal x50% increased damage to Injured enemies for 8 seconds.

Player attacks are guaranteed to Critically Strike for the duration of the Eagle Spirit.

the-hunter-exalted.d: Killing an enemy while The Hunter is present has a 40% chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.

the-devourer-harmonious.d:
As it emerges, The Devourer launches 10 toxic globs that apply 210% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds wherever they land.

Enemies affected by toxic globs also take x100% increased Poison Damage.

the-devourer-exalted.d: While The Devourer is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned they die instantly and unleash a Pestilent Swarm that deals 30% damage per hit to enemies it passes through.

command-fallen-fallen-army.d: Command Fallen now summons up to 3 Fallen Grunts for 20 seconds which deal 48% damage and generate 10 Wrath per hit. Recasting while all are active will direct them to move or target on your command. Command Fallen is now an Abyss Skill.

bombardment-endless-cascade.d: Bombardment now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for 10 seconds afterward. This effect can stack up to 5 times. Bombardment is now a Hellfire Skill.

bombardment-mangled-demons.d: Each Bombardment impact has a 40% chance to leave behind mutilated demons for 6 seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing 20% damage.

bombardment-ramping-brutality.d: Each cast of Bombardment within 3 seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to 4 additional.

wall-of-agony-fallen-rush.d: When Wall of Agony expires demon brutes remain for 5 seconds and attack Nearby enemies.

rampage-v2-wrath.d: Casting Rampage compels your Lesser Demon Skills to generate 0 Wrath per hit for 5 seconds.

rampage-v2-elite-eviscerate.d: Rampage has a 100% chance to Eviscerate Elite enemies that are not already Eviscerated.

infernal-breath-volatility.d: Casting Infernal Breath infuses your Lesser Demon Skills to grant 1 seconds of Volatility per hit for 5 seconds.

apocalypse-close-damage.d: Apocalypse deals up to x25% increased damage the closer enemies are to you. Hexed enemies always take the maximum damage.

apocalypse-volatility.d: Apocalypse's final hit has a 20% chance to hit twice. When Apocalypse is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%.

apocalypse-doom-bomb.d: Apocalypse launches a Doom Bomb with at least 20 Doom Stacks that deals 33% damage. Hellfire Skill hits generate up to 100 Doom Stacks, each stack increases the bomb's explosion size and damage by x0.6%.

Whenever you cast Clash, gain Crusader's
March for 6 seconds.

Crusader's March grants you x15% Block
Chance and 2 stacks of Resolve.

Casting Advance grants you Unhindered for
2 seconds.

blessed-shield-enhanced.d: Blessed Shield deals 1% additional damage for each Armor on your shield.

blessed-hammer-enhanced.d: Blessed Hammer now hits enemies multiple times.

divine-lance-enhanced.d:
Divine Lance's damage is increased by 30%
of your Movement Speed bonus.

shield-bash-enhanced.d:
Hits with Shield Bash counts as Blocks.
This effect can trigger once per Cast.

discipline.d: Your Core Skills deal x 6% increased damage.

en-guarde.d: You gain + 10% Armor and + 5% Block Chance.

riposte.d: Blocking grants you 6% damage for 5 seconds.

piety.d: Your Maximum Faith is increased by 5 .

Fanaticism Aura's passive also grants you
and your allies 10% Maximum Resource.

defiance-aura-enhanced.d:
Defiance Aura's passive also grants you and
your allies 10% Maximum Life.

holy-light-aura-enhanced.d: Holy Light's passive now targets 2 additional enemies.

anointing.d: Your allies Heal for + 11% of the Healing you receive.

renewal.d: Blocking Fortifies you for 0.5% of your Maximum Life.

shield-charge-v2-enhanced.d: Shield Charge grants 1 Resolve whenever it hits an enemy.

aegis-enhanced.d: Casting Aegis grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

resolute.d: Gaining a stack of Resolve Heals for 0.5% of your Maximum Life.

conviction.d: Gain + 0.3% Attack Speed for each stack of Resolve up to 3% .

attenuate.d: Gain + 1% Resource Cost Reduction for every stack of Resolve up to + 5% .

courage.d: You gain 1 Resolve every 7 seconds an Elite enemy is Nearby.

falling-star-enhanced.d:
Killing a Vulnerable enemy reduces the
cooldown of Falling Star by 1 second.

rally-enhanced.d:
Rally's increases your Movement Speed by
an additional 10% and generates 5
additional Faith.

the-best-offense.d: You deal x 6% increased damage while Fortified.

fortitude.d: Gain x 6% Critical Strike Damage while Fortified.

thorns-and-thistles.d: Gain [X] Thorns and your total Thorns damage is increased by x 15% .

purify-enhanced.d:
Purify generates 10 Faith for each enemy
affected by Purify.

crack-in-the-armor.d: You deal x 6% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

consecration-enhanced.d:
While inside Consecration, you and your
allies deal x15% additional damage and
consume x15% less resource.

condemn-enhanced.d:
While Casting Condemn, become
Unhindered for 1.5 seconds.

condemn-shepard-the-flock.d: Condemn's build up marks all enemies and drags them to your location after it Casts.

iron-sharpens-iron.d: You gain x 6% Critical Strike Damage.

break-the-line.d: You have a + 2% increased Critical Strike Chance and deal x 5% increased Damage to Weakened enemies.

press-the-advantage.d: Critically Striking grants you 3% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds.

heavyweight.d: You deal x 6% increased Critical Strike Damage while Healthy.

spear-of-the-heavens-enhanced.d:
Consuming Judgement reduces Spear of the
Heavens active cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

pacify.d: You gain + 15% increased Crowd Control duration.

dizzying-blow.d: You deal x 7% increased damage to Crowd Controled enemies.

righteousness.d: You deal x 6% increased Holy and Fire damage.

fortress-enhanced.d:
While inside of your Fortress your Skills are
free to Cast and you gain x4% damage
per stack of Resolve.

shining-armor.d:
Gain a bonus based on your equipped weapon and armor qualities:
- Unique Weapon or Shield: Gain x 5% Damage
- Unique Helmet, Chest or Pants: Gain + 5% Armor

giant-slayer.d: You deal x 5% increased damage to Elites and x 8% increased damage to Healthy enemies.

sacred-arms.d:
Gain a bonus based on your equipped weapon types:
- Two Handed: Gain x 5% Critical Strike Damage.
- One Handed and Shield: 5% chance to ignore damage.

zenith-enhanced.d: While Zenith is active, you are Unstoppable.

arbiter-of-justice-enhanced.d: Arbiter form's Wing Strikes recast time is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

master-craftwork.d: Your Armor is increased by 50% of your Shield's Block Chance.

shake-it-off.d: You have a 8% chance to become Unstoppable for 1 second after being hit by a Crowd Control Effect.

bash-enhanced.d: Clobbering an enemy grants you 10% Maximum Life as Fortify.

bash-battle.d: Clobbering an enemy generates an additional 10 Fury.

bash-combat.d: After Critically Striking 4 times with Bash using a Two-Handed weapon, your next Core or Weapon Mastery Skill will Overpower.

flay-enhanced.d: Flay has a 50% chance to make the enemy Vulnerable for 5 seconds. Double this chance when using a Two-Handed weapon.

flay-battle.d: When Flay deals direct damage to an enemy, they take x15% increased Bleeding damage from you for the next 3 seconds.

flay-combat.d: When Flay deals direct damage to an enemy, you gain 4% Damage Reduction and [X] Thorns for 6 seconds. This stacks up to 5 times.

frenzy-enhanced.d: While Frenzy is granting +60% bonus Attack Speed, the Fury costs of your Core Skills are reduced by 25%.

frenzy-battle.d: While Berserking, your other skills gain +6% Attack Speed for each stack of Frenzy you have.

frenzy-combat.d: You gain 5% Damage Reduction and 5% Movement Speed per stack of Frenzy you currently have.

lunging-strike-enhanced.d: Lunging Strike deals x30% increased damage and Heals you for 2% Maximum Life when it damages a Healthy enemy.

lunging-strike-battle.d: Lunging Strike also inflicts 40% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

lunging-strike-combat.d: Critical Strikes with Lunging Strike grant you Berserking for 3 seconds.

double-swing-enhanced.d: Hitting an enemy with both hits of Double Swing makes them Vulnerable for 2 seconds.

double-swing-violent.d: If Double Swing damages a Stunned or Knocked Down enemy, gain 25 Fury.

double-swing-furious.d: Casting Double Swing while Berserking grants 2 additional seconds of Berserking.

hammer-of-the-ancients-enhanced.d: Gain 10% more Fury and 10% more Maximum Fury for 5 seconds for each enemy damaged by Hammer of the Ancients, stacking up to 10 times.

hammer-of-the-ancients-violent.d: After Overpowering with Hammer of the Ancients, you deal x40% more damage for 5 seconds.

rend-enhanced.d: Dealing direct damage with Rend extends the duration of Vulnerable on enemies by 2 seconds.

rend-violent.d: Rend deals x30% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

rend-furious.d: Direct damage with Rend grants 5 Fury per enemy hit, up to a maximum of 25 Fury.

upheaval-enhanced.d: Upheaval has a 45% chance to Stun all enemies it damages for 3 seconds.

upheaval-violent.d: If Upheaval damages at least 2 enemies or a Boss, you gain Berserking for 3 seconds, increased to 5 seconds if it damages at least 4 enemies.

upheaval-furious.d: Dealing direct damage to an enemy with a Skill that is not Upheaval causes your next cast of Upheaval to deal x20% increased damage, stacking up to 10 times.

whirlwind-enhanced.d: Gain 1 Fury each time Whirlwind deals direct damage to an enemy, or 4 Fury against Elite enemies.

whirlwind-violent.d: Channeling Whirlwind for 2 seconds increases the damage of your next Weapon Mastery Skill by 35% if used immediately after Whirlwind ends.

whirlwind-furious.d: While using a Slashing weapon, Whirlwind also inflicts 120% Weapon Damage as Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

challenging-shout-enhanced.d: While Challenging Shout is active, gain x20% bonus Maximum Life.

challenging-shout-tactical.d: While Challenging Shout is active, you gain 6 Fury each time you take damage.

challenging-shout-strategic.d: While Challenging Shout is active, gain Thorns equal to 30% of your Maximum Life.

ground-stomp-enhanced.d: Ground Stomp generates 60 Fury and Pulls in enemies.

ground-stomp-tactical.d: Ground Stomp is now a Brawling Skill and deals x100% increased damage. It also applies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

ground-stomp-strategic.d: Reduce the Cooldown of your Ultimate Skill by 5 seconds per enemy damaged by Ground Stomp, up to 15 seconds.

iron-skin-enhanced.d: Iron Skin grants Unhindered for 5 seconds and its Barrier absorbs 30% more of your Maximum Life.

iron-skin-tactical.d: While Iron Skin is active, Heal for 20% of the Barrier's original amount as Life per second.

iron-skin-strategic.d: Iron Skin also grants 10% Maximum Life as Fortify. Double this amount if cast while below 50% Life.

rallying-cry-enhanced.d: Rallying Cry grants you Unstoppable while active.

rallying-cry-tactical.d: Rallying Cry generates 20 Fury and grants you an additional x20% Resource Generation.

rallying-cry-strategic.d: While Rallying Cry is active, gain 1% Maximum Life as Fortify every second.

charge-enhanced.d: Enemies who are Knocked Back into terrain by Charge take 150% damage and are Stunned for 3 seconds.

charge-mighty.d: Damaging enemies with Charge makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

charge-power.d: Reduce Charge's Cooldown by 2 seconds for each enemy it hits, up to 6 seconds. Charging a boss reduces the Cooldown by 6 seconds.

kick-enhanced.d: Damaging enemies with Kick reduces the cooldown of your Mobility Skills by 5 seconds per enemy, and also makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

kick-mighty.d: Kicked enemies deal 100% damage to enemies they collide with while being Knocked Back. Enemies damaged this way are Knocked Down for 4 seconds.

leap-enhanced.d: If Leap doesn't damage any enemies, its Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

leap-mighty.d: Leap deals x40% increased damage and surrounding enemies are Knocked Back on impact.

leap-power.d: If Leap damages at least one enemy, gain 40 Fury.

war-cry-enhanced.d: War Cry grants you Berserking for 4 seconds.

war-cry-mighty.d: War Cry grants you 8% Maximum Life as Fortify.

war-cry-power.d: If at least 6 enemies are Nearby when you cast War Cry, your damage bonus is increased by an additional x10%.

death-blow-enhanced.d: Death Blow deals x200% increased damage to Bosses.

death-blow-warriors.d: If Death Blow damages at least one enemy, gain Berserking for 3 seconds.

death-blow-fighters.d: If Death Blow damages at least one enemy, gain 20 Fury.

rupture-enhanced.d: Ripping your weapon out of enemies during Rupture causes an explosion that deals 70% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds. This damage is increased by x35% for each 50 Strength you have.

rupture-warriors.d: Hitting enemies with Rupture increases your Attack Speed by +40% for 5 seconds.

rupture-fighters.d: Hitting at least 1 enemy with Rupture Heals you for 22% of your Maximum Life.

steel-grasp-enhanced.d: Steel Grasp also makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

steel-grasp-fighters.d: Steel Grasp's damage is increased by x200% and if it damages an enemy you gain Berserking for 2 seconds.

mighty-throw-enhanced.d: Mighty Throw grants 25% increased Attack Speed for 6 seconds.

mighty-throw-warriors.d: Mighty Throw's impact deals x50% increased damage and Stuns enemies for 2 seconds.

mighty-throw-fighters.d: Swapping weapons near any of your thrown weapons creates an additional pulse. Mighty Throw generates 20% of your Maximum Life as a Barrier for 6 seconds.

call-of-the-ancients-prime.d: While Call of the Ancients is active, gain +20% bonus Attack Speed and x30% increased damage.

call-of-the-ancients-supreme.d:
Each of the Ancients gains additional power:

Korlic: You gain 10 Fury each time Korlic damages an enemy with his Frenzy.

Talic: Enemies are Slowed by 50% for 1 second when damaged by his Whirlwind.

Madawc: 30% chance to Stun enemies for 3 seconds when using his Upheaval.

iron-maelstrom-prime.d: Iron Maelstrom gains +30% increased Critical Strike Chance and deals x50% increased Critical Strike Damage

iron-maelstrom-supreme.d: Swapping weapons reduces Iron Maelstrom's Cooldown by 1 second.

wrath-of-the-berserker-prime.d: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, gain +20% increased Movement Speed and increase Fury Generation by x30%.

wrath-of-the-berserker-supreme.d: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, every 50 Fury you spend increases Berserking's damage bonus by x25%, up to x100%.

battle-fervor.d: When a Brawling Skill damages at least one enemy, gain Berserking for 1 seconds.

booming-voice.d: Your Shout Skill effect durations are increased by x 8% .

brute-force.d: Your Overpowers deal x 8% increased damage when using a Two-Handed weapon.

concussion.d: Lucky Hit: Skills using Bludgeoning Weapons have up to a 20% chance to Stun enemies for 2 seconds, or up to a 30% chance when using a Two-Handed Bludgeoning Weapon. This also deals 30% Physical damage to them.

cut-to-the-bone.d: Your Bleeding effects deal x 5% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

duelist.d: Attack Speed is increased by + 3% while using One-Handed weapons.

endless-fury.d: Basic Skills generate x 12% more Fury.

expose-vulnerability.d: Dealing direct damage with a Weapon Mastery skill causes your next Core Skill to make enemies Vulnerable for 1 second.

furious-impulse.d: Each time you swap weapons, gain 2 Fury.

gushing-wounds.d:
When causing an enemy to Bleed, you have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to increase the Bleed amount by x70%, and also increased by +100% of your Critical Strike Damage bonus.
Overpowering a Bleeding enemy creates an explosion that inflicts 150% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

guttural-yell.d: Your Shout Skills cause enemies to deal 4% less damage for 5 seconds.

hamstring.d: The first time you apply a Bleeding effect to an enemy, Slow them by 70% for 2 seconds.

heavy-handed.d: While using Two-Handed weapons you deal x 6% increased Critical Strike Damage.

invigorating-fury.d: Heal for 3% of your Maximum Life for each 100 Fury spent.

martial-vigor.d: Damage Reduction against Elites is increased by 6% .

no-mercy.d: You gain + 3% increased Critical Strike Chance.

outburst.d: Gain [X] Thorns. Also gain [X] Thorns for each 20 bonus Maximum Life you have.

pit-fighter.d: You deal x 3% increased damage to Close enemies and gain 2% Damage Reduction.

pressure-point.d: Lucky Hit: Your Core and Weapon Mastery skills have up to a 10% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 2 seconds.

prolific-fury.d: While Berserking, Fury Generation is increased by x 6% .

quick-impulses.d: Reduce the duration of Control Impairing Effects by 6% .

raid-leader.d: Your Shouts also Heal allies for 1% of their Maximum Life per second.

slaying-strike.d: You deal 5% increased damage to Injured and Healthy enemies.

thick-skin.d: Each time you take direct damage gain 0.1% Maximum Life as Fortify.

tough-as-nails.d: Increase your Thorns by + 3% . When enemies hit you, they take an additional 15% of your Thorns as Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

unbridled-rage.d: Your Core Skills deal 50% increased damage but cost 100% more Fury. The damage is doubled against Injured enemies.

unconstrained.d: Berserking's damage bonus is increased to x60%. While not Healthy, you are always Berserk and gain a x30% Physical Damage Reduction bonus.

walking-arsenal.d: Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants x15% increased damage for 15 seconds. While all three bonuses are active, you gain Unstoppable and +45% Attack Speed.

wallop.d: Your Skills using Bludgeoning weapons deal x 5% increased damage if the enemy is Stunned or Vulnerable.

barbed-carapace.d:
For every 25 Fury you spend, you gain +10% Thorns for 8 seconds, up to 120%.

lair-bosses.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

lair-of-plenty.d:
Lair Bosses have +1 **Monster Power**.

Gain +1 **Hoard Chest** when you slay a Lair Boss (excluding Belial).

infernal-deception.d: Belial can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.

two-by-two.d:
After opening a **Hoard Chest**, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the Nemesis Lair, where you will fight two Initiate Lair Bosses at the same time.

Slaying both will yield great rewards.

You cannot enter a Nemesis Lair from Belial's throne room.

At Rank 18 with the Splinter of Destruction, the chance for a portal is increased.

nemesis-tides.d:
Initiate Lair Bosses have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events.

Killing Lair Bosses in Helltides while earning the Event Mastery grants many random Lair Boss materials.

This only occurs in Torment+ difficulties.

exotic-armory.d:
**Hoard Chests** drop one additional Unique Item, but it can be for any Class.

At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Destruction, **Hoard Chests** drop an additional 3 Unique Items for any Class.

greater-nemesis.d:
After completing a Nemesis Lair, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a Greater Nemesis Lair. Within this heinous place lies two Greater Lair Bosses.

Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.

lair-of-runes.d:
Lair Bosses have +1 **Monster Power**.

Lair Bosses have a higher chances of dropping specific Runes.

At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Destruction, Lair Bosses drop additional Runes.

ultimate-nemesis.d:
After defeating all Bosses within the Greater Nemesis Lair, the Call Of Evil will appear. This altar will accept 3 Superior Lair Keys and open a Portal that takes you to the Ultimate Nemesis Lair.

Inside the Ultimate Nemesis Lair, all enemies gain +5 **Monster Power**. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 **Hoard Chests** worth of Items.

golden-hoard.d: All equipment that would drop from **Hoard Chests** are converted to Gold, except for Unique and Mythic items.

grigoires-gambit.d:
After opening a Tortured Gift in Helltides, there is a chance Grigoire's knights will ambush you.

When killed in Helltide, they may drop Unique Items available from his **Hoard Chest**.

duriels-invasion.d:
When summoning the Blood Maiden in Helltides, there is a chance Duriel can be summoned instead.

Killing Duriel in Helltides can now drop Unique Items from his **Hoard Chest**.

out-of-the-cold.d:
When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Beast in Ice has a chance to appear and attack you.

When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop Unique Items from the Beast in Ice's **Hoard Chest**.

children-of-zir.d:
When exploring the Pit, Lord Zir's Bloodseekers can now ambush you.

Killing them in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from his **Hoard Chest**.

dog-of-astaroth.d:
When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Amalgam of Rage has a chance to appear and attack you.

Killing the Amalgam of Rage in Nightmare Dungeons can drop Unique Items associated with Astaroth

embers-of-anguish.d:
When exploring the Pit, Embers of Anguish can appear. Activating one drops **Progress Orbs**, and causes Andariel to ambush you at the end of the Pit.

Killing Andariel in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from her **Hoard Chest**.

blood-of-bartuc.d:
The Fell Council in the Infernal Hordes has +1 **Monster Power**.

After defeating the Fell Council, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items associated with Bartuc.

varshans-vengeance.d:
Varshan and his minions can now appear in a Chaos Wave within the Infernal Hordes.

After killing Varshan in the Infernal Hordes, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items available from his **Hoard Chest**.

helltide.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

night-terrors.d:
You have a chance to be ambushed by Hellborne in Nightmare Dungeons.

Hellborne have a small chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.

hells-prize.d:
Hell's Prize chests will now appear in Helltide.

These chests offer a massive torrent of items for 666 **Aberrant Cinders**.

fall-of-the-fell.d:
Harbingers will emerge from falling meteors twice as often, and drop twice as many **Aberrant Cinders** when slain.

Harbingers in Helltide have +1 **Monster Power**.

meat-brothers.d:
Instead of Hellborne, two Butchers that are connected with flaming chains ambush you.

These Butchers each have a high chance to drop a **Profane Mindcage** when slain.

hellmouth.d:
When a **Hellwyrm** emerges, it unleashes one of the following:

- A Chaos Rift, which releases varied rewards upon collapse.
- Maggots, which burst out Experience Orbs when slain.
- Bloodseekers, which are more likely to drop Ancestral items when slain.

At Rank 12 with the Splinter of Terror, **Hellwyrms** have a chance to make you smell of Fresh Meat!

wretched-vermin.d:
Demonic Rats will frequently attack you in Helltide.

At Rank 4 with the Splinter of Terror, Demonic Rats are always Elite, which drop more Aberrant Cinders.

ashes-to-ashes.d:
On death, lose all your **Aberrant Cinders**.

For every 100 **Aberrant Cinders** you pick up, you gain an additional 10.

undying-embers.d: You lose no **Aberrant Cinders** on death.

infernal-rite.d:
Ambushes spawn up to four additional Hellborne.

Hellborne have a higher chance to drop Unique items when slain.

planar-tremors.d:
**Hellwyrms** will always open a Chaos Rift, and enemies that emerge from it gain +1 **Monster Power**.

The first time a Chaos Rift opens, there is a chance that another will open.

tainted-shrines.d:
While empowered by a Shrine in Helltide, slain enemies grant double the progress to your **Threat Level**.

At Rank 18 with the Splinter of Terror, Shrine effects in Helltide last 15 seconds longer and grant 50% increased Movement Speed.

hated-foe.d: Maximum Threat enemies that ambush you gain +1 **Monster Power**.

chaotic-echoes.d: Collapsed Chaos Rifts have a chance to reopen.

bursting-brood.d: Maggots and Pangs of Duriel explode when killed and will often drop Boss Trophies.

writhe-and-rot.d:
**Hellwyrms** will always spew Maggots that gain +1 **Monster Power**.

Sometimes, a Pang of Duriel will also crawl forth. Lair Keys often burst out of Pangs of Duriel.

bound-by-blood.d:
Bloodseekers are connected with flaming chains.

When slain, Bloodseekers drop items that match the category of the last opened Tortured Gift.

crimson-scent.d:
**Hellwyrms** will always call forth Bloodseekers that gain +1 **Monster Power**.

Greater Bloodseekers may also emerge, which have a high chance to drop Legendary items when slain.

infernal-hordes.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

exalted-council.d: Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 **Monster Power** and drop additional items when slain.

council-coffers.d:
The Chest of Talismans will appear after defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc.

At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Terror, the Chest of Talismans now costs 1 Aether.

infernal-hoard.d: Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.

forged-in-flame.d: Obducite drops instead of Gem Fragments in the Infernal Hordes.

flawless-find.d: Gem Fragments drop instead of Obducite in the Infernal Hordes.

method-and-madness.d: Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.

impending-doom.d:
When the current wave has 10 seconds remaining, Aether Events spawn at all locations.

At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Terror, Impending Doom also triggers when the current wave has 30 seconds remaining.

the-black-pact.d:
An ominous altar appears between waves in the Infernal Hordes.

It can be invoked only once, and provides an Infernal Offering that shares a category with your previous choice.

reign-in-hell.d:
An additional Infernal Offering appears each wave.

However, you suppress Chaos Waves from appearing.

total-chaos.d:
Chaos Waves appear more frequently.

However, one less Infernal Offering appears each wave.

bedlam.d: When you enter a Chaos Wave, gain +50 Aether and all enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 **Monster Power**.

pulse-of-aether.d:
Suppressing a Chaos Wave grants +50 Aether.

All enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 **Monster Power**.

cult-of-annihilation.d:
Doomsayers appear during the Infernal Hordes.

Doomsayers are dangerous enemies but also drop Aether.

At Rank 5 with the Splinter of Terror, a Doomsayer appears at the start of each wave.

scale-of-tathamet.d: Once per wave the Scale of Tathamet may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the Infernal Hordes.

devils-deal.d:
At the start of the Infernal Hordes, gain an Infernal Challenge.

Completing the Infernal Challenge will grant +200 Aether.

nightmare-dungeons.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

branching-pathways.d: When advancing to the next dungeon in a Nightmare Escalation, 2 additional Horadric Portals appear.

fearless-conviction.d:
While in a Nightmare Dungeon, killing Elites and Champions grants you stacks of Conviction.

Getting hit by an Elite or Champion causes you to lose a stack of Conviction.

A Conviction Chest appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining Conviction. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award Attuned Primordial Dust.

goblinfall.d: Treasure Goblins have a small chance to drop a Nightmare Sigil with the Treasure Breach affix.

nemesis.d: Activating a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon causes up to 7 Elites to ambush you.

gauntlet.d:
While in a Nightmare Dungeon, slaying an enemy while empowered by a Shrine traps their soul within you.

When the Shrine buff expires, all trapped souls escape and spawn around you as renewed enemies.

Souls will be lost when moving between dungeons in an Escalation Dungeon.

horadric-hunter.d:
Kill 25 Elites across Nightmare Dungeons to reveal a Horadric Altar. Activating it results in one of the following outcomes:

- Summon Elites
- Summon Treasure Goblins
- Summon The Butcher
- Gain Riches
- Terrible Misfortune

At Rank 12 with the Splinter of Hatred, killing any Elite in a Nightmare Dungeons has a chance to reveal a Horadric Altar.

altar-of-avarice.d: Horadric Altars are replaced with Goblin Altars that only summon Treasure Goblins.

cipher-maps.d: Whenever you would reveal a Horadric Altar, you reveal 2 instead.

rewarded-faith.d: Gain a random additional buff when claiming a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon.

greed-is-good.d: Killing a Treasure Goblin in a Nightmare Dungeon has a small chance to spawn a portal that takes you to the Goblin's Retreat.

waking-spoils.d:
After completing a Nightmare Dungeon, a War's Bounty Chest will spawn that grants additional rewards.

At Rank 4 with the Splinter of Hatred, there is a 50% chance to spawn a second War's Bounty Chest.

recurring-nightmare.d:
Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons gain +1 **Monster Power** and have a chance to drop an Escalation Sigil when slain.

Escalation Sigils can only appear in Torment+ difficulty.

dread-revival.d:
Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons have a chance to revive when slain.

At Rank 8 with the Splinter of Hatred, Bosses have a higher chance to revive, and gain +1 **Monster Power**.

the-pit.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

chorons-haste.d:
The Pit gains the Haste Mastery objective.

When you kill the **Guardian** gain +1 **Glyph Upgrade Chance** for every 5 minutes left on the Timer.

At Rank 18 with the Splinter of Hatred, gain +1 additional **Glyph Upgrade Chance** for every 5 minutes left.

damned-thieves.d:
Orb Thieves have a chance to spawn in The Pit.

Orb Thieves drop an immense amount of **Progress Orbs** when killed, but leave a trail of Traps in their wake.

heart-of-stone.d:
Begin The Pit carrying the Heart of Stone, a fragile relic that is dropped after taking sustained damage and breaks after dropping 10 times.

While you carry it, enemies can drop bonus **Progress Orbs**.

After slaying the Guardian, Choron's Pedestal appears. Deposit the Heart of Stone within to gain +1 **Glyph Upgrade Chance**.

chorons-blessing.d:
Gain +1 **Glyph Upgrade Chance** for completing The Pit.

At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Hatred, your Glyph Upgrade Success Chance is increased as if you completed 10 tiers higher.

chorons-favor.d: Special events and encounters become more common in higher **Difficulty Tiers** of The Pit.

chorons-soul.d:
Choron's Soul now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Soul will drop 1 **Progress Orb** per **Glyph Upgrade Chance** offered.

All **Progress Orbs** in The Pit now grant Experience.

chorons-flesh.d:
Choron's Flesh now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Flesh will allow you to get valuable Equipment by consuming one of your **Glyph Upgrade Chances**.

chorons-shortcut.d:
Choron's Portal randomly appears in The Pit.

When used, it will send you to the entrance to the next Pit Floor, or become Unstable and summon either an Elite or a Shrine.

cursed-rituals.d:
Different Ritual Sites now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:

- Choron's Blood appears in foliage dense regions
- Choron's Sweat appears in stony locations
- Choron's Tears appears in mystical places

Sacrificing these Materials at Ritual Sites may grant Gold, Materials, Items, and more.

pit-butcher.d:
The Butcher has a chance to appear anywhere in The Pit.

The Butcher is a **Guardian** and killing him will complete the run.

However, you fail the run if he kills any player.

cursed-merchant.d:
The Cursed Merchant has a chance to appear when completing the Pit.

The Cursed Merchant will sell Equipment for **Artificers Stones**.

cursed-offerings.d:
Cursed Machines have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit.

Cursed Machines cost **Artificers Stones** to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies.

The more Cursed Machines you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.

chorons-wager.d:
Choron's Wager can appear in The Pit.

Activate it with **Artificer's Stones** to acquire a challenge, which grants a large amount of **Artificer's Stones** when completed.

At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Hatred, gain 50% more **Artificer's Stones**.

the-undercity.d: Complete War Plans with this Activity to unlock upgrade points.

idols-of-war.d: Greater Tributes of Armament more frequently drop throughout Sanctuary and have an additional Bargain choices.

trials-and-tributes.d:
For each **Portal Prankster** you slay within the Undercity, a Tribute Chest appears after killing the District Boss.

Tribute Chests are unlocked by offering a **Tribute**.

gutter-filth.d:
When you activate any Beacon within the Undercity, there is a small chance to summon a **Portal Prankster**.

Invasion Portals will sometimes summon Rats of varying amounts.

endless-swarm.d:
Invasion Portals now appear in the Undercity.

The enemies that emerge grant **Attunement** when slain.

At Rank 8 with the Splinter of Destruction, an Invasion Portal appears at the start of each floor.

jade-epiphany.d:
When you gain an **Attunement** level in the Undercity, Experience Orbs appear around you.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 **Monster Power**.

At Rank 4 with the Splinter of Destruction, you gain 50% more Experience Orbs and **Monster Power** is increased by +1 more.

finely-tuned.d:
Gain additional Tuning Prisms when completing the Undercity at maximum **Attunement**.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 **Monster Power**.

pathfinder.d:
When you reach maximum **Attunement**, a portal to the final floor of the Undercity appears.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 **Monster Power**.

unfortunate-souls.d:
Invasion Portals can now summon Wisps that attach to you and vanish if you die.

Each Wisp you save will reward you with Forgotten Souls and other Crafting Materials at the end of the run.

initiative.d:
When you find the District Boss you gain the Initiative buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining Time. Initiative is lost upon death.

If you slay the District Boss with Initiative active, you receive **Tribute** rewards as if your **Attunement** was 2 higher (max 6).

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 **Monster Power**.

last-gasp.d:
Time collected from slain enemies with 5 seconds or less remaining in the Undercity doubles the Time earned.

At Rank 12 with the Splinter of Destruction, Last Gasp now triggers at 15 seconds or less remaining.

bauble-day.d:
If you slay a **Portal Prankster** within the Undercity, the Cabochon Merchant will appear after killing the District Boss.

The Cabochon Merchant will sell you Runes and Gems for Gold.

tree-of-whispers.d: Complete Whispers to unlock upgrade points.

tree-of-plenty.d: The Tree offers a fourth **Whisper Cache** choice.

headrotten-feast.d: Headrotten Bosses that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 **Monster Power**, and will always drop a **Whisper Cache**.

resplendent-favor.d:
Each **Whisper Cache** has a chance to drop a Resplendent Spark.

At Rank 22 with the Splinter of Hatred, if you would gain a Resplendent Spark this way, gain 2 instead.

malignant-invasion.d:
Varshan can now appear in a Whisper Ambushes.

Slay Varshan to earn the contents of an Ancestral Collection of Chaos .

grim-retribution.d:
Completing a Whisper has a chance to trigger a Whisper Ambush.

These enemies have a chance to burst out the contents of a Collection of Chaos when slain.

At Rank 5 with the Splinter of Destruction, Whisper Ambush triggers more often.

roots-of-power.d:
Enemies that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 **Monster Power**.

Planting Corrupted Roots in Helltides yields double rewards.

At Rank 22 with the Splinter of Terror, **Monster Power** is increased by +1 more. Planting Corrupted Roots in Helltides yields a large amount of Aberrant Cinders.

colossal-foe.d:
Whisper Ambushes sometimes include Bosses.

These Bosses will always burst out the contents of a Greater Collection of Chaos when slain.

At Rank 22 with the Splinter of Destruction, Boss Ambushes have +2 **Monster Power** and drop Superior Lair Keys.

simple-gifts.d: The Tree only offers one **Whisper Cache** choice that will always be a Material Collection or a Collection of Chaos.

corrupted-roots.d:
**Whisper Caches** sometimes contain Corrupted Roots.

Plant Corrupted Roots to grow an Exposed Root. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies.

The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.

At Rank 8 with the Splinter of Terror, Corrupted Roots appear more often in **Whisper Caches**.

wisdom-of-whispers.d:
Gain 50% more Experience Orbs in **Whisper Caches**.

At Rank 5 with the Splinter of Hatred, completing Whispers also grants Experience Orbs.

fortune-or-famine.d: **Whisper Caches** from the Tree of Whispers are always at least of Greater Quality... or Junk.

material-wealth.d: The Tree now only offers Material Collections.

grim-mysteries.d:
Collections of Chaos are replaced with Collections of Mysteries.

These caches can drop anything.

chaotic-favor.d: Completing a Whisper has a small chance to award a Collection of Chaos.
